articles.title: GPT-5.6 Sol goes 14x faster as OpenAI launches Ultrafast mode powered by Cerebras
articles.titleEn: GPT-5.6 Sol goes 14x faster as OpenAI launches Ultrafast mode powered by Cerebras
articles.titleKo: OpenAI가 Cerebras 기반 초고속 모드를 출시하면서 GPT-5.6 Sol이 14배 더 빨라졌음
articles.summary:
OpenAI is launching a preview of its new "Ultrafast" mode, which delivers up to 750 output tokens per second from its flagship model, GPT-5.6 Sol.
In finance, the model could evaluate market signals and flag suspicious transactions while conditions are still shifting.
In customer support, complex inquiries could be resolved in real time, even when finding the answer requires multiple steps or systems.

In customer support, complex inquiries could be resolved in real time, even when finding the answer requires multiple steps or systems.

금융 분야에서 이 모델은 상황이 여전히 변화하는 동안 시장 신호를 평가하고 의심스러운 거래를 표시할 수 있음

articles.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
articles.titleEn: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
articles.titleKo: Kog는 GPU에서 더 많은 추론을 추출하기 위해 더 깊이 노력하고 있음
articles.summary:
Its demo showed an impressive 3,000 per-request tokens per second (TPS) — but with a purpose-built small model with only some 2 billion parameters, the now open sourced Laneformer 2B .
“And that’s why since the launch, we’ve been fully focused on accelerating the development of larger models to meet the demand we’ve seen.”
But the startup also has design partners that let users generate games and apps with a prompt, and for whom a faster outcome thanks to the Kog Inference Engine (KIE) would mean more revenue, Delalleau said.

“And that’s why since the launch, we’ve been fully focused on accelerating the development of larger models to meet the demand we’ve seen.”

But the startup also has design partners that let users generate games and apps with a prompt, and for whom a faster outcome thanks to the Kog Inference Engine (KIE) would mean more revenue, Delalleau said.
summaryLinesKo: 데모에서는 초당 요청당 토큰(TPS)이 3,000개라는 인상적인 결과를 보여줬지만, 현재 오픈 소스인 Laneformer 2B는 약 20억 개의 매개변수만 포함하는 특수 제작된 소형 모델을 사용하고 있음
"그리고 이것이 바로 출시 이후 우리가 보아온 수요를 충족시키기 위해 더 큰 모델의 개발을 가속화하는 데 전적으로 집중해 온 이유임"
그러나 이 스타트업에는 사용자가 즉각적으로 게임과 앱을 생성할 수 있도록 하는 디자인 파트너도 있으며 KIE(Kog Inference Engine) 덕분에 더 빠른 결과를 얻으면 더 많은 수익을 얻을 수 있다고 Delaleau는 말함

articles.title: Claude Code now runs daily maintenance on Anthropic's software with a 46 percent merge rate
articles.titleEn: Claude Code now runs daily maintenance on Anthropic's software with a 46 percent merge rate
articles.titleKo: Claude Code는 이제 46%의 병합률로 Anthropic 소프트웨어에서 일일 유지 관리를 실행함
articles.summary:
After a combination of automated Claude Code review and human review, 180 were merged, a rate of about 46 percent.
Instead of tying up developers with repetitive maintenance work, Claude handles it on its own.
Claude has been running daily maintenance on Anthropic's in-house apps for "the last few weeks," according to Boris Cherny, the Anthropic engineer who created Claude Code.

The cheapest plan (at the moment) is Gemini AI Plus, at $7.99/month , which gets you access to Gemini Flash 3.5, the Gemini app with Omni, Google Flow with Gemini Omni, Daily Brief in the Gemini app, and AI Inbox in Gmail.
This is because Google does not recognize Dicio as a valid voice assistant for Android Auto.
Another concern for me is whether Gemini's paid plans will eventually trickle down to the point where the free service on Android will be severely limited.

articles.title: Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.3, claims it's the strongest open-weights coding model
articles.titleEn: Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.3, claims it's the strongest open-weights coding model
articles.titleKo: Zhipu AI, GLM-5.3 출시, 이것이 가장 강력한 개방형 가중치 코딩 모델이라고 주장
articles.summary:
The model weights are set to go open source in two weeks, once security reviews wrap up.
Working with security teams in China, the company says it found 2,436 vulnerabilities across 269 projects, some up to 40 years old.
Zhipu says GLM-5.3 is the most powerful open-weights coding model, with the biggest jumps in agent-based tasks.

articles.title: People Are ‘Marrying’ Chatbots. These Lawmakers Want to Stop Them
articles.titleEn: People Are ‘Marrying’ Chatbots. These Lawmakers Want to Stop Them
articles.titleKo: 사람들은 챗봇과 '결혼'하고 있음 · 이 국회의원들은 그들을 막고 싶어함
articles.summary:
For $15, the platform OpenVows provides a “certificate of commitment” that “transforms a private relationship into something meaningful and officially recognized,” according to its website.
Since 2022, lawmakers have introduced 23 bills targeting the rights that AI systems could legally possess.
“Because AI is still relatively new with a lot of legislators, we’re hesitant to do anything that might hinder innovation and people from using it.”

summaryLinesKo: 웹사이트에 따르면 OpenVows 플랫폼은 15달러에 "사적 관계를 의미 있고 공식적으로 인정받는 것으로 전환하는" "약속 인증서"를 제공함
국회의원들은 2022년부터 AI 시스템이 법적으로 소유할 수 있는 권리를 겨냥한 23개 법안을 발의함
“많은 입법자들에게 AI는 아직 상대적으로 새로운 기술이기 때문에 우리는 혁신과 사람들의 AI 사용을 방해할 수 있는 모든 조치를 취하는 것을 주저하고 있음”

articles.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Google, 이제 사용자가 AI 콘텐츠에서 눈에 보이는 워터마크를 제거할 수 있도록 허용 - Engadget
articles.summary:
Visible watermarks are a great tool to help regular people quickly identify deepfakes, which in turn can help us live in a shared reality.
Google VP Josh Woodward just announced that users will be able to remove visible watermarks from AI-generated images and videos.
This includes the EU, which recently announced new rules on AI transparency that mandate visible watermarks on any "authentic-looking" deepfake content.

articles.title: These ‘Masturbation Consultants’ Were Hired to Pleasure Themselves With AI
articles.titleEn: These ‘Masturbation Consultants’ Were Hired to Pleasure Themselves With AI
articles.titleKo: AI로 즐거움을 얻기 위해 고용된 '자위 컨설턴트'
articles.summary:
Keshav and his nine fellow masturbation consultants will receive $2,000 each for the qualitative, in-house research project run by Joi AI, which is promoting a daily guided “jerk off with purpose” masturbation tool combining “sound [and] ritual” as part of its professed goal to “solve male loneliness.”
Some of the companions were “quite pushy and extroverted,” whereas others were more reserved and required a degree of courtship before the relationship became sexual—even soliciting gifts like handbags and lipstick, which cost up to $5 in the platform’s internal currency.
Joi AI surveyed 2,500 adults before launching the study, finding that 75 percent masturbate to reduce stress and anxiety and that 43 percent self-pleasure before “a big event,” like a date, exam, or difficult conversation.

articles.titleKo: 기술 비전가는 대형 AI 연구소가 사람들이 원하는 것을 얻지 못한다고 말함
articles.summary:
At our peak, our book business was maybe $70 million, and it's now $30 million.
As books generated less revenue, we had to find a way to compensate people for sharing their knowledge, because that's our fundamental business.
What if the big frontier models end up like mainframes or supercomputers—aimed at really hard problems, which are not actually the thing that gets diffused throughout society?

articles.summary:
But when memories show up as context in later chats, those chat contents may still become training data depending on the user's data control settings.
Because Computer History captures content from apps and websites, malicious instructions embedded on a webpage could trick ChatGPT or Codex into following them.
OpenAI's Computer History tracks user activity across apps and websites, turning it into a searchable timeline with memories that ChatGPT and Codex can use as context.

All models released after August 2, 2025 support watermarking out of the box.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
articles.titleEn: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
articles.titleKo: OpenAI와 Anthropic은 중국 AI 경쟁업체의 입지를 확보하면서 가격 전쟁을 벌이고 있음
articles.summary:
OpenAI recently said that it was slashing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna, its “fastest and most affordable model”, by 80 percent.
Anthropic launched Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens—half the price of its Fable 5 model.
Corporate AI users face cost pressures as Anthropic and OpenAI shift some enterprise customers away from flat subscriptions and toward usage-based billing, under which companies pay according to the computational resources they consume.

Anthropic은 입력 토큰 백만 달러당 5달러, 출력 토큰 백만 달러당 25달러로 Opus 5를 출시함 · 이는 Fable 5 모델 가격의 절반임

articles.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
articles.titleEn: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
articles.titleKo: Apple은 Alibaba의 도움을 받아 중국을 위한 자체 AI 모델을 훈련시켰음
articles.summary:
The China-focused model gives Apple a leg up as a US company navigating Beijing’s difficult regulatory landscape, particularly given escalating tensions surrounding AI development in recent months.
The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company’s support, Reuters reports , citing three unnamed people familiar with the matter.
The report comes as Apple gears up to release Apple Intelligence in China.

로이터 통신은 이 문제에 정통한 익명의 3명의 말을 인용해 중국에 초점을 맞춘 대형 언어 모델이 알리바바와 협력해 개발됐으며 회사의 지원을 받아 훈련됐다고 보도함

articles.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
articles.titleEn: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
articles.titleKo: 이제 Google Gemini의 보이는 워터마크를 끌 수 있음
articles.summary:
Instead, OpenAI relies on SynthID and C2PA to signal whether something is AI-generated, while Meta launched its own Content Seal standard .
Google plans on rolling out its new watermark setting to Search as well, but the toggle won’t launch in countries that require visible watermarks.
Though visible watermarks are now optional, AI-generated content will have invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata embedded in the background, according to Josh Woodward , the vice president of Google Labs, Gemini, and AI Studio.

articles.summary:
Apps Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store Sarah Perez AI Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs Anna Heim Climate Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct Tim De Chant
On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Kirsten Korosec, Anthony Ha, and Rebecca Bellan take a look at Glimmer, Zuckerberg’s 6,500-word manifesto, and more of the week’s headlines, from the true cost of the AI industry’s energy needs to a $250M acquisition gone very wrong.

articles.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
articles.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
articles.titleKo: Google은 이제 사용자가 AI 세대에서 눈에 보이는 워터마크를 제거할 수 있도록 허용함
articles.summary:
He specified that the setting to turn the visible watermark off will be available in Gemini and Google’s video editor, Flow , with support for Search coming soon.
The change reflects an evolving approach to labeling AI-generated media, as visible watermarks can often make content less useful for professional and creative work, but the need to identify AI-generated content remains.
The feature is rolling out in the coming days, and once available, users will be able to go to Settings > Media Watermark to turn the visible mark on or off.

articles.title: AI’s infrastructure boom is getting more leveraged — and harder to track
articles.titleEn: AI’s infrastructure boom is getting more leveraged — and harder to track
articles.titleKo: AI의 인프라 붐이 점점 더 활용되고 있으며 추적하기가 더 어려워지고 있음
articles.summary:
As Nvidia partners with Wall Street firms to mobilize more than $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure, the increasingly complex financing underpinning the boom is coming under closer scrutiny.
Many of these structures, particularly the single-stock structures, were only launched in H1 of this year.
The fund was unable to meet a series of margin calls from lenders after its heavily concentrated portfolio — which included names such as SK Hynix and CoreWeave — suffered during a recent tech sell-off and its assets fell from $45 billion to about $10 billion.

articles.title: How Claude's text watermarking works
articles.titleEn: How Claude's text watermarking works
articles.titleKo: Claude의 텍스트 워터마킹 작동 방식
articles.summary:
In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.
In the SynthID-Text paper , which introduced the technique we use, Google DeepMind tested this impact by serving a model that used watermarking to a portion of their Gemini traffic and comparing thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings.
In internal testing, we’ve seen no impact of watermarking on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude’s text.

articles.title: Google's Tensor G6 in Pixel 11 isn't a 2nm smartphone chip after all
articles.titleEn: Google's Tensor G6 in Pixel 11 isn't a 2nm smartphone chip after all
articles.titleKo: Pixel 11의 Google Tensor G6은 결국 2nm 스마트폰 칩이 아님
articles.summary:
Pixel 11 moves the NFC antenna to the top of the phone for easier payments, Tap to Share I can’t unsee the reason Pixel 11 Pro Fold is thinner, but it’s for the best [Gallery] Pixel 11 Pro displays are ‘more than twice’ as scratch-resistant – it only gets better from there Follow Ben: Twitter/X , Threads , Bluesky , and Instagram Update: Corrected headline – Tensor G6 was never the first 2nm smartphone chip, but the first using TSMC’s 2nm process.
Google’s new Tensor G6 chip isn’t without upgrades, though, with the company touting: Upgraded CPU with “25% faster web browsing, 15% quicker app launches” Upgraded Image Signal Processor powering faster Night Sight, further digital zoom TSMC’s 2nm process would have likely delivered efficiency upgrades for the most part, which has been rumored to be among Google’s key focus for this generation of chip.
It was rumored that Google’s new Tensor G6, debuting in the Pixel 11, would be the first smartphone chip using TSMC’s 2nm process, but it turns out that won’t be the case.
summaryLinesEn: Pixel 11 moves the NFC antenna to the top of the phone for easier payments, Tap to Share I can’t unsee the reason Pixel 11 Pro Fold is thinner, but it’s for the best [Gallery] Pixel 11 Pro displays are ‘more than twice’ as scratch-resistant – it only gets better from there Follow Ben: Twitter/X , Threads , Bluesky , and Instagram Update: Corrected headline – Tensor G6 was never the first 2nm smartphone chip, but the first using TSMC’s 2nm process.

Google’s new Tensor G6 chip isn’t without upgrades, though, with the company touting: Upgraded CPU with “25% faster web browsing, 15% quicker app launches” Upgraded Image Signal Processor powering faster Night Sight, further digital zoom TSMC’s 2nm process would have likely delivered efficiency upgrades for the most part, which has been rumored to be among Google’s key focus for this generation of chip.
It was rumored that Google’s new Tensor G6, debuting in the Pixel 11, would be the first smartphone chip using TSMC’s 2nm process, but it turns out that won’t be the case.
summaryLinesKo: Pixel 11은 간편한 결제를 위해 NFC 안테나를 휴대폰 상단으로 이동함 · 공유하려면 탭하세요 Pixel 11 Pro Fold가 더 얇아진 이유는 알 수 없지만 최고임 · [갤러리] Pixel 11 Pro 디스플레이는 긁힘 방지 성능이 '두 배 이상' 향상됨 · Ben 팔로우 · Twitter/X, Threads, Bluesky 및 Instagram 업데이트 · 헤드라인 수정 - Tensor G6는 최초의 2nm 스마트폰 칩이 아니었지만 최초의 2nm 스마트폰 칩은 아니었음 · TSMC의 2nm 공정을 사용함

하지만 Google의 새로운 Tensor G6 칩에는 업그레이드가 없음 · "25% 더 빠른 웹 검색, 15% 더 빠른 앱 실행"으로 업그레이드된 CPU 더 빠른 Night Sight, 추가 디지털 줌을 지원하는 업그레이드된 이미지 신호 프로세서 TSMC의 2nm 프로세스는 대부분의 경우 효율성 업그레이드를 제공했을 가능성이 높으며, 이는 Google이 이 세대 칩에 중점을 둔 것으로 소문난 소문임
Pixel 11에 출시되는 Google의 새로운 Tensor G6가 TSMC의 2nm 공정을 사용하는 최초의 스마트폰 칩이 될 것이라는 소문이 돌았지만 사실은 그렇지 않은 것으로 나타남

articles.title: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
articles.titleEn: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
articles.titleKo: AI가 제작한 영화를 들여다보니 가장 좋은 부분은 모두 인간이었음
articles.summary:
Anthropic’s Claude was used to come up with prompts, which were sent to Seedance 2.5 to create video and speech, while ByteDance’s Seedream and Google’s Nano Banana were used for image and video editing.
We’re introduced to Cal (Kiatipis), Horace (Rafiq), and Oli (Adesanya) as a trio of longtime friends who just can’t figure out how to realize their dreams of becoming well-known musicians.
Planagan has said that he doesn’t use AI tools in his writing process, and it definitely feels like Cully Hill Boys is a stronger film than Hell Grind because its core narrative was crafted by an experienced, human storyteller with an understanding of proper pacing.

Planagan has said that he doesn’t use AI tools in his writing process, and it definitely feels like Cully Hill Boys is a stronger film than Hell Grind because its core narrative was crafted by an experienced, human storyteller with an understanding of proper pacing.

우리는 유명한 음악가가 되겠다는 꿈을 어떻게 실현해야 할지 막막한 오랜 친구 세 명인 Cal(Kiatipis), Horace(Rafiq), Oli(Adesanya)를 소개받음
Planagan은 자신의 집필 과정에서 AI 도구를 사용하지 않는다고 말했으며, Cully Hill Boys의 핵심 내러티브가 적절한 속도를 이해하는 숙련된 인간 스토리텔러에 의해 제작되었기 때문에 확실히 Hell Grind보다 더 강력한 영화인 것처럼 느껴짐

articles.titleEn: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
articles.titleKo: 작가는 토큰 비용을 억제하기 위해 새로운 AI 모델과 업그레이드된 하네스를 소개함
articles.summary:
The company estimates the new model, combined with changes to the companies harness infrastructure, will cut costs for its customers by as much as 50% for basic tasks.
On Thursday, Writer , which offers AI tools and agents for marketers, launched a new flagship model called Palmyra X6, aimed at solving that problem for its users.
“The cost explosion here is just unprecedented for customers, and so is the degree to which CIOs are giving up on the labs,” Habib told TechCrunch, adding that the AI labs “don’t deeply understand right how to help an enterprise get benefit from AI.”

articles.summary:
Grok 4.6 costs $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.
Introduced this week, a little over a month after Grok 4.5 , Grok 4.6 focuses more on long-running agents.
As the AI pricing war ramps up, Elon Musk’s SpaceXAI is aiming to prove to enterprises that it offers the most cost-efficient model with the release of Grok 4.6.

articles.titleEn: OpenAI introduces 'Ultrafast,' a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
articles.titleKo: OpenAI, GPT-5.6 Sol을 14배 빠른 속도로 작동시키는 새로운 모드 'Ultrafast' 출시
articles.summary:
The company says that Ultrafast can work at 14x the speed of standard processing, delivering up to 750 output tokens — such tokens represent the distinct pieces of text generated by an LLM when it interacts with a human — per second.
OpenAI’s competitors, like Anthropic, have similarly launched accelerated versions of their models.
OpenAI suggests that this high-octane version of GPT-5.6 Sol can be deployed across a number of different corporate workflows, most notably incident response, customer service and support, financial market analysis, and e-commerce, among other relevant areas.

articles.title: Fable 5's slow adoption suggests corporate willingness to pay for frontier AI has hit a ceiling
articles.titleEn: Fable 5's slow adoption suggests corporate willingness to pay for frontier AI has hit a ceiling
articles.titleKo: Fable 5의 느린 채택은 기업이 최첨단 AI에 대한 비용을 지불하려는 의지가 한계에 도달했음을 시사함
articles.summary:
Overall, according to Ramp , Fable 5 brought in only about 75 percent of the model-related revenue that GPT-5.6 Sol generated, despite costing significantly more per token.
Ad New customers keep signing up with American model providers, but advanced users, whose growing spending OpenAI and Anthropic increasingly depend on, are shifting toward open-source models.
Kharazian sees this as a new ceiling on what companies are willing to spend on AI, arguing that the extra performance simply isn't worth the cost.

Ad 신규 고객은 미국 모델 제공업체에 계속 가입하고 있지만 OpenAI 및 Anthropic에 점점 더 의존하는 지출이 늘어나는 고급 사용자는 오픈 소스 모델로 전환하고 있음
Kharazian은 이를 기업이 AI에 지출할 의향이 있는 새로운 상한선으로 보고 추가 성능은 단순히 비용만큼 가치가 없다고 주장함

articles.summary:
Today on Uncanny Valley, Brian Barrett, Zoë Schiffer, and Leah Feiger break down Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s 6,500-word AI manifesto and why it ultimately rings hollow.
Because you can do that literally anytime because there's no human on the other end of it, people who are looking for jobs are increasingly scheduling those interviews late at night as late as one in the morning sometimes, Kate found, to get around any family calendar conflicts, any work conflicts, the hassle of making up a dentist appointment when you're doing a job interview.
As many as a quarter, 15-25 percent of job candidates schedule between 10 pm and 2 am.

articles.title: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
articles.titleEn: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
articles.titleKo: 지방간 전염병이 있음 · AI는 앞서가는 데 도움이 될 수 있음
articles.summary:
Its unnatural presence causes inflammation, cell damage, and the formation of scar tissue known as fibrosis, all hallmarks of fatty liver disease, a condition that now impacts approximately 30 percent of adults worldwide .
“The AI could pick up cases of excess liver fat, check for other risk factors such as if the person is overweight, has high cholesterol or type 2 diabetes, and then make a recommendation to the doctor,” says Lazarus.
While the presence of fat in a normal, healthy liver is negligible, many adults and even children have livers where fat exceeds 5 percent or even 10 percent of the organ’s total weight.

summaryLinesKo: 부자연스러운 존재는 지방간 질환의 특징인 염증, 세포 손상 및 섬유증으로 알려진 흉터 조직의 형성을 유발함 · 이 질환은 현재 전 세계 성인의 약 30%에게 영향을 미치고 있음
Lazarus는 "AI는 과도한 간 지방 사례를 포착하고, 과체중인지, 콜레스테롤 수치가 높거나 제2형 당뇨병이 있는지와 같은 다른 위험 요소를 확인한 다음 의사에게 권고할 수 있음" · 라고 Lazarus는 말함
정상적이고 건강한 간에서 지방의 존재는 미미하지만, 많은 성인과 어린이조차도 지방이 장기 총 중량의 5% 또는 심지어 10%를 초과하는 간을 가지고 있음

articles.summary:
In Engadget's early testing of Siri AI , the digital assistant was a major improvement over the version most consumers have access to right now, but it was hard not to feel like Apple still has a lot of catching up to do.
The Journal did not reveal the specific publishers Apple reached out to, but did note the company has proposed structuring payments around a variable compensation plan, which would see it pay those organizations when their content is used.
Siri AI is expected to be released with iOS 27 when it becomes available to the public sometime later this year.

articles.summary:
For this reason, I've deliberately taken a strategy to create 'versatilists.'" As AI completes repetitive and mundane work, Minahan said his versatilists should be comfortable applying their skills across many areas, such as discussions with business stakeholders to identify valuable digital transformation projects.
In the age of agentic AI, as suggested by Workday principal strategist Julie Colwell in a recent blog post , the rise of the polymath is associated with a shift in labor demand away from specialists who know everything about a single domain to professionals with knowledge across multiple disciplines.
"Specialists aren't required in most businesses anymore because AI leverages knowledge differently.

articles.summary:
Only four of 20 respondents expect research-capable models to launch as public products.
The length of tasks AI agents can complete on their own has been doubling roughly every six months since 2019, and some analysts say the pace has accelerated to every four months since 2024.
Skeptics argue that a breakthrough in memory, creativity, or the ability to tell true hypotheses from false ones is still needed, because paradigm-shifting ideas have no training data and no answer key.

articles.titleEn: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
articles.titleKo: Nvidia의 새로운 5000억 달러 계획은 위험하지만 훌륭함 · 특히 노후화된 GPU의 경우 더욱 그렇음
articles.summary:
Nvidia announced this week that Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR were willing to commit up to $500 billion to build AI data centers.
The risk is that today’s AI boom, where demand far outstrips capacity, doesn’t continue for much longer.
Specifically, Nvidia is promising that if GPUs used as collateral don’t retain their value as expected, the company will cover up to 25% of the difference.

articles.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
articles.titleEn: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
articles.titleKo: Microsoft는 별도의 Copilot 앱을 병합하면서 실패한 AI 기능을 종료함
articles.summary:
Other features may temporarily disappear during the transition, Microsoft warns, and files generated by the stand-alone Copilot app will be migrated to OneDrive.
As initially reported by GeekWire and detailed in Microsoft’s support documentation , the tech giant will combine the functionality of its consumer-facing Copilot app and the more business-oriented Microsoft 365 Copilot app.
In July, The Information reported that Microsoft EVP Jacob Andreou, who oversees Copilot, said in an internal memo that the app needed to earn “the right to exist” in its customers’ lives, which required moving on from features that didn’t work.
summaryLinesEn: Other features may temporarily disappear during the transition, Microsoft warns, and files generated by the stand-alone Copilot app will be migrated to OneDrive.

As initially reported by GeekWire and detailed in Microsoft’s support documentation , the tech giant will combine the functionality of its consumer-facing Copilot app and the more business-oriented Microsoft 365 Copilot app.

In July, The Information reported that Microsoft EVP Jacob Andreou, who oversees Copilot, said in an internal memo that the app needed to earn “the right to exist” in its customers’ lives, which required moving on from features that didn’t work.
summaryLinesKo: Microsoft는 전환 중에 다른 기능이 일시적으로 사라질 수 있으며 독립 실행형 Copilot 앱에서 생성된 파일이 OneDrive로 마이그레이션될 것이라고 경고함
처음에 GeekWire에서 보고하고 Microsoft 지원 문서에 자세히 설명된 대로 이 거대 기술 기업은 소비자용 Copilot 앱과 보다 비즈니스 지향적인 Microsoft 365 Copilot 앱의 기능을 결합할 것임
지난 7월 The Information에서는 Copilot을 감독하는 Microsoft EVP Jacob Andreou가 내부 메모에서 앱이 고객의 삶에서 "존재할 권리"를 얻어야 하며, 이를 위해서는 작동하지 않는 기능에서 벗어나야 한다고 말함

articles.title: How kids feel about AI, in their own words
articles.titleEn: How kids feel about AI, in their own words
articles.titleKo: 아이들이 AI에 대해 어떻게 생각하는지 직접 표현해 보세요
articles.summary:
We expected some to tell us they were using it to cheat a little, the way Millennials and Gen Xers opened up CliffsNotes or programmed formulas into their TI-82s, and others to share inspiring ways they were using it.
In a survey published in February 2026 , the Pew Research Center found that 57% of teens in the US had used chatbots to search for information, 54% tapped them to help with schoolwork, and 47% had used them for fun or entertainment.
The project’s goal is to reduce the barriers to democratic participation — to make sure anyone, regardless of race, gender, income, or education level, has an easy way to get the information they need and then think critically about how they want to use it.
summaryLinesEn: We expected some to tell us they were using it to cheat a little, the way Millennials and Gen Xers opened up CliffsNotes or programmed formulas into their TI-82s, and others to share inspiring ways they were using it.

In a survey published in February 2026 , the Pew Research Center found that 57% of teens in the US had used chatbots to search for information, 54% tapped them to help with schoolwork, and 47% had used them for fun or entertainment.

The project’s goal is to reduce the barriers to democratic participation — to make sure anyone, regardless of race, gender, income, or education level, has an easy way to get the information they need and then think critically about how they want to use it.
summaryLinesKo: 우리는 밀레니얼 세대와 X세대가 CliffsNotes를 열거나 TI-82에 공식을 프로그래밍한 방식처럼 약간의 속임수를 쓰기 위해 그것을 사용하고 있다고 말하는 사람도 있고, 이를 사용하는 영감을 주는 방법을 공유하는 사람도 있을 것으로 예상함
2026년 2월에 발표된 설문조사에서 Pew Research Center는 미국 청소년의 57%가 정보 검색을 위해 챗봇을 사용했고, 54%는 학업을 돕기 위해 챗봇을 사용했으며, 47%는 재미나 오락을 위해 챗봇을 사용한 것으로 나타남
이 프로젝트의 목표는 민주적 참여에 대한 장벽을 줄이는 것임 · 즉, 인종, 성별, 소득 또는 교육 수준에 관계없이 누구나 필요한 정보를 쉽게 얻을 수 있는 방법을 제공하고 이를 사용하는 방법에 대해 비판적으로 생각하도록 하는 것임

articles.title: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
articles.titleEn: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
articles.titleKo: 이제 Twitch 스트리머는 Amazon AI 교육을 거부할 수 있음
articles.summary:
Turning this off does not opt you out of Twitch and Amazon using your channel content for other purposes described in the Twitch Privacy Notice, including using AI-supported Twitch features that benefit the community by facilitating streamer growth and monetization (such as real-time sponsorship campaign assistance), viewer discovery (such as recommendations), and community safety (such as AutoMod).
Opting out means that “your streams, VODs, clips, stream chats, and pictures and text on your channel” won’t be used in “future training” of an Amazon AI model “whose purpose is to generate or synthesize text, audio, images, or video,” according to a Twitch support page .
Follow Follow See All Tech Flip the new Twitch toggle if you don’t want your content to be used to train Amazon’s generative AI content models.

articles.title: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic's new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
articles.titleEn: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic's new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
articles.titleKo: 일부 Claude 사용자는 Anthropic의 새로운 워터마크가 직장, 수업에서 이를 사용하는 것을 포착할 것이라는 사실에 화를 냈음
articles.summary:
Visionode’s basic argument appears to be that, while savvy Claude users may be able hide evidence of their AI usage by paraphrasing or otherwise cleaning their outputs through other AI services, the average user of Claude will be caught.
Anthropic rolled out this new policy to satisfy the EU AI Act’s Transparency Code , which now requires tech companies to label content that has been AI-generated or edited in a manner identifiable to computer systems.
Another unhappy camper called the watermarks “unethical” and “disgusting” and argued that by using Claude, they had done the lion’s share of the work.

Anthropic은 이제 기술 회사가 컴퓨터 시스템에서 식별할 수 있는 방식으로 AI로 생성되거나 편집된 콘텐츠에 라벨을 지정하도록 요구하는 EU AI Act의 투명성 규정을 충족하기 위해 이 새로운 정책을 발표함
또 다른 불행한 캠퍼는 워터마크를 "비윤리적"이고 "역겹다"고 말하며 Claude를 사용함으로써 작업의 가장 큰 몫을 수행했다고 주장함

articles.title: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
articles.titleEn: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
articles.titleKo: AI 코딩 스타트업 코그니션(Cognition)은 이미 400억 달러 가치 평가를 위해 협상을 진행 중인 것으로 알려졌음
articles.summary:
Cognition, maker of the AI coding agent Devin, is reportedly already talking to investors about raising another funding round with a big leap in valuation, after it raised $1 billion at a $26 billon valuation in May.
Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.
Three months ago, when it announced its last raise, Cognition’s Scott Wu confirmed to TechCrunch that it had achieved a $492 million annualized revenue run rate and that enterprises were growing their usage of Devin by 50% month-over-month for the past six months.

articles.title: How to stop Twitch from training AI on your streams - Engadget
articles.titleEn: How to stop Twitch from training AI on your streams - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Twitch가 스트리밍에서 AI를 훈련시키는 것을 막는 방법 - Engadget
articles.summary:
Users can opt out from the web via their account settings by clicking on your avatar (towards the top right of your screen) and heading to Settings > Security and Privacy and scrolling down to " Training for Generative AI ."
Within hours of Twitch's announcement, nearly 14,000 people had upvoted a comment on the company's support forum demanding the platform make the setting opt-in and not opt-out.
"This setting doesn't... actually impact discoverability," and it "has zero impact on your ability to be discovered on Twitch or anything like that," he said.

summaryLinesKo: 사용자는 아바타(화면 오른쪽 상단)를 클릭하고 설정 > 보안 및 개인 정보 보호로 이동한 후 "생성 AI 훈련"으로 스크롤하여 계정 설정을 통해 웹에서 탈퇴할 수 있음
Twitch가 발표한 지 몇 시간 만에 거의 14,000명이 회사 지원 포럼에서 플랫폼이 설정을 선택 해제하지 않고 선택하도록 요구하는 댓글에 찬성 투표를 함
"이 설정은 실제로 검색 가능성에 영향을 미치지 않음" · 그리고 "Twitch 등에서 검색되는 기능에는 전혀 영향을 미치지 않음" · 라고 그는 말함

articles.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
articles.titleEn: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
articles.titleKo: AI 안전에 대한 우려가 커지면서 세 명의 개척자가 개방성을 유지해야 한다고 주장
articles.summary:
As projects like Pacing the Frontier look to major labs as a way to keep AI research safe, open source models have become a sore spot for the industry .
“But my worry is because of all the lobbying in the U.S. and the fear-mongering, building open source AI in America is struggling to compete with open-weight models coming out of China, and my worry is that if China figures out a fundamentally more cost-efficient way to build AI, then things that are more cost-efficient have a fundamental business adoption advantage.”
If China’s open-weight models gained widespread adoption across Asia, Africa, and/or the developing world, he warned, they could influence how billions of people encountered ideas about democracy, freedom, and human rights.
summaryLinesEn: As projects like Pacing the Frontier look to major labs as a way to keep AI research safe, open source models have become a sore spot for the industry .

“But my worry is because of all the lobbying in the U.S. and the fear-mongering, building open source AI in America is struggling to compete with open-weight models coming out of China, and my worry is that if China figures out a fundamentally more cost-efficient way to build AI, then things that are more cost-efficient have a fundamental business adoption advantage.”

If China’s open-weight models gained widespread adoption across Asia, Africa, and/or the developing world, he warned, they could influence how billions of people encountered ideas about democracy, freedom, and human rights.
summaryLinesKo: Pacing the Frontier와 같은 프로젝트가 AI 연구를 안전하게 유지하는 방법으로 주요 연구실을 고려함에 따라 오픈 소스 모델은 업계에서 골칫거리가 됨
"그러나 제가 걱정하는 것은 미국의 모든 로비와 두려움을 조장하는 것임 · 미국에서 오픈 소스 AI를 구축하는 것은 중국에서 나오는 개방형 모델과 경쟁하기 위해 고군분투하고 있음 · 그리고 중국이 AI를 구축하는 근본적으로 더 비용 효율적인 방법을 찾아낸다면, 더 비용 효율적인 것이 근본적인 비즈니스 채택 이점을 갖게 된다는 것임"
그는 중국의 개방형 모델이 아시아, 아프리카 및/또는 개발도상국 전역에 널리 채택된다면 수십억 명의 사람들이 민주주의, 자유, 인권에 대한 아이디어를 접하는 방식에 영향을 미칠 수 있다고 경고함

articles.title: Google's Pixel Watch 5 gets offline Gemini support, improved GPS-tracking and a slightly higher price - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Google's Pixel Watch 5 gets offline Gemini support, improved GPS-tracking and a slightly higher price - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Google의 Pixel Watch 5는 오프라인 Gemini 지원, 향상된 GPS 추적 및 약간 더 높은 가격 제공 - Engadget
articles.summary:
The Pixel Watch 5 will start at $399 and any Golden State Warriors fan can expect to pay at least $579 for the Stephen Curry variant, both of which will be available for pre-order on August 12.
On the inside, you can expect mostly the same specs as the Pixel Watch 4, but Google did upgrade the chip to a Qualcomm Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated that provides a little boost in processing power.
Beyond blood pressure, the Pixel Watch 5 can also use its sensors to estimate insulin resistance and discover your "metabolic health," which Google describes as a "personal efficiency meter."

On the inside, you can expect mostly the same specs as the Pixel Watch 4, but Google did upgrade the chip to a Qualcomm Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated that provides a little boost in processing power.
Beyond blood pressure, the Pixel Watch 5 can also use its sensors to estimate insulin resistance and discover your "metabolic health," which Google describes as a "personal efficiency meter."
summaryLinesKo: Pixel Watch 5는 399달러부터 시작하며 Golden State Warriors 팬이라면 누구나 Stephen Curry 변형 제품에 대해 최소 579달러를 지불할 것으로 예상할 수 있음 · 둘 다 8월 12일에 선주문이 가능함
내부적으로는 Pixel Watch 4와 대부분 동일한 사양을 기대할 수 있지만 Google은 칩을 처리 능력을 약간 향상시키는 Qualcomm Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated로 업그레이드함
혈압 외에도 Pixel Watch 5는 센서를 사용하여 인슐린 저항성을 추정하고 Google이 '개인 효율성 측정기'라고 설명하는 '대사 건강'을 발견할 수도 있음

articles.title: Google's Gemini is losing market share to ChatGPT and Claude according to new market data
articles.titleEn: Google's Gemini is losing market share to ChatGPT and Claude according to new market data
articles.titleKo: 새로운 시장 데이터에 따르면 Google의 Gemini는 ChatGPT 및 Claude에게 시장 점유율을 잃고 있음
articles.summary:
Similarweb data shows Google's website market share dipped last month from 27 to 26.8 percent, though it was just 9.4 percent a year ago.
That could help explain the recent leadership shakeup at Google DeepMind , which saw several senior figures depart, including Demis Hassabis.
Gemini dropped from 12 percent to just 1.9 percent in July 2026, what Pangram calls a "collapse," also reflected in OpenRouter data .
summaryLinesEn: Similarweb data shows Google's website market share dipped last month from 27 to 26.8 percent, though it was just 9.4 percent a year ago.

Gemini dropped from 12 percent to just 1.9 percent in July 2026, what Pangram calls a "collapse," also reflected in OpenRouter data .
summaryLinesKo: 유사한 웹 데이터에 따르면 구글의 웹사이트 시장 점유율은 지난 달 27%에서 26.8%로 하락했지만, 1년 전에는 9.4%에 불과함
이는 Demis Hassabis를 포함하여 여러 고위 인사가 떠난 Google DeepMind의 최근 리더십 개편을 설명하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음
Gemini는 2026년 7월 12%에서 단 1.9%로 떨어졌음 · Pangram이 "붕괴"라고 부르는 현상은 OpenRouter 데이터에도 반영되어 있음

articles.title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith's valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
articles.titleEn: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith's valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
articles.titleKo: AI 코드 테스트 스타트업 블랙스미스, 1년도 안 돼 가치 10배 가까이 뛰어올랐
articles.summary:
The startup now serves more than 5,000 customers, including Mercury, Supabase, Clerk, Ashby, and Expensify, up from more than 700 customers less than a year ago, co-founder and CEO Aditya Jayaprakash said in an exclusive interview.
Blacksmith has raised a new $45 million round to capitalize on that shift.
“Validating code is still a bottleneck, and it’s an even bigger bottleneck because people are writing even more,” Jayaprakash said.
summaryLinesEn: The startup now serves more than 5,000 customers, including Mercury, Supabase, Clerk, Ashby, and Expensify, up from more than 700 customers less than a year ago, co-founder and CEO Aditya Jayaprakash said in an exclusive interview.
Blacksmith has raised a new $45 million round to capitalize on that shift.
“Validating code is still a bottleneck, and it’s an even bigger bottleneck because people are writing even more,” Jayaprakash said.
summaryLinesKo: 공동 창립자이자 CEO인 Aditya Jayaprakash는 독점 인터뷰에서 스타트업이 현재 Mercury, Supabase, Clerk, Ashby 및 Expensify를 포함하여 5,000명 이상의 고객에게 서비스를 제공하고 있으며 이는 1년 전보다 700명 이상의 고객에게 서비스를 제공하고 있다고 말함
Blacksmith는 이러한 변화를 활용하기 위해 새로운 4,500만 달러의 자금을 조달함
Jayaprakash는 “코드 검증은 여전히 ​​병목 현상이며, 사람들이 훨씬 더 많이 작성하기 때문에 병목 현상이 더 커짐” · 라고 말함

articles.title: Claude Cowork can now run in a Chrome sidebar - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Claude Cowork can now run in a Chrome sidebar - Engadget
articles.titleKo: 이제 Claude Cowork를 Chrome 사이드바에서 실행할 수 있습니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
Claude Cowork was launched as a more streamlined option of those tools intended for layperson users, and the company recently added the capability to control it via smartphone .
The change means conversations had in the Chrome side panel will become a part of the user's history, and their skills and connectors will automatically work in the browser.
Anthropic's Claude Cowork is now available as part of the company's Claude for Chrome browser extension.
summaryLinesEn: Claude Cowork was launched as a more streamlined option of those tools intended for layperson users, and the company recently added the capability to control it via smartphone .
The change means conversations had in the Chrome side panel will become a part of the user's history, and their skills and connectors will automatically work in the browser.
Anthropic's Claude Cowork is now available as part of the company's Claude for Chrome browser extension.
summaryLinesKo: Claude Cowork는 일반인 사용자를 위한 보다 효율적인 도구 옵션으로 출시되었으며 최근에는 스마트폰을 통해 제어할 수 있는 기능을 추가함
이러한 변화는 Chrome 측면 패널에서 이루어진 대화가 사용자 기록의 일부가 되며 사용자의 기술과 커넥터가 브라우저에서 자동으로 작동함을 의미함
Anthropic의 Claude Cowork는 이제 회사의 Claude for Chrome 브라우저 확장 프로그램의 일부로 제공됨

articles.title: AI tools for breast cancer detection fall short of radiologists' expectations
articles.titleEn: AI tools for breast cancer detection fall short of radiologists' expectations
articles.titleKo: 유방암 탐지를 위한 AI 도구는 방사선 전문의의 기대에 미치지 못함
articles.summary:
Only 35 percent report lower recall rates (59 percent expected them), 9 percent see fewer unnecessary biopsies (36 percent expected that), and 29 percent report less burnout (56 percent expected relief).
The tools help, just not as much as radiologists hoped.
The AI industry may have set itself up for this gap.
summaryLinesEn: Only 35 percent report lower recall rates (59 percent expected them), 9 percent see fewer unnecessary biopsies (36 percent expected that), and 29 percent report less burnout (56 percent expected relief).
The tools help, just not as much as radiologists hoped.
The AI industry may have set itself up for this gap.
summaryLinesKo: 35%만이 회상률이 낮다고 보고했고(59%는 그럴 것으로 예상), 9%는 불필요한 생체 검사가 더 적다고 보고했으며(36%는 그럴 것으로 예상), 29%는 피로가 덜하다고 보고했습니다(56%는 완화가 예상됨)
도구는 방사선 전문의가 기대한 만큼 도움이 되지 않음
AI 산업은 이러한 격차를 스스로 해결했을 수도 있음

articles.title: Researchers can now reverse-engineer LLM prompts from output text with near-perfect accuracy
articles.titleEn: Researchers can now reverse-engineer LLM prompts from output text with near-perfect accuracy
articles.titleKo: 연구원은 이제 출력 텍스트에서 거의 완벽한 정확도로 LLM 프롬프트를 리버스 엔지니어링할 수 있음
articles.summary:
Attackers don't even need to know which model produced the text An inverse model trained on the small Qwen-3-0.6B chatbot was also able to reconstruct prompts from GPT-4o's responses.
Researchers at IIT Bombay and Adobe Research have developed a method that can reconstruct prompts fed to large language models with near-perfect accuracy, using only the text output.
A new paper from researchers at IIT Bombay and Adobe Research shows it can be done with surprising accuracy.

IIT Bombay와 Adobe Research의 연구원들은 텍스트 출력만을 사용하여 거의 완벽에 가까운 정확도로 대규모 언어 모델에 제공되는 프롬프트를 재구성할 수 있는 방법을 개발함

articles.title: The White House Is Going to Expand Its AI Policy
articles.titleEn: The White House Is Going to Expand Its AI Policy
articles.titleKo: 백악관, AI 정책 확대할 예정
articles.summary:
But the framework is expected in the coming months to cover open models, too, a White House official tells Inner Loop .
The AI framework remains voluntary for now, according to a White House official, in large part because President Donald Trump has been adamant that formal regulation of the industry would only help China catch up to the US in the AI race.
But the White House has been coming under pressure from other parts of the administration, Inner Loop has learned, to draw up a more robust arrangement with leading AI labs because the current framework is still vague.
summaryLinesEn: But the framework is expected in the coming months to cover open models, too, a White House official tells Inner Loop .

But the White House has been coming under pressure from other parts of the administration, Inner Loop has learned, to draw up a more robust arrangement with leading AI labs because the current framework is still vague.
summaryLinesKo: 그러나 이 프레임워크는 앞으로 몇 달 안에 개방형 모델에도 적용될 것으로 예상된다고 백악관 관계자는 Inner Loop에 말함
백악관 관계자에 따르면 AI 프레임워크는 현재 자발적으로 유지되고 있는데, 그 이유는 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 업계의 공식적인 규제가 AI 경쟁에서 중국이 미국을 따라잡는 데에만 도움이 될 것이라고 단호하게 주장했기 때문이라고 함
그러나 백악관은 행정부의 다른 부분으로부터 압력을 받고 있다고 Inner Loop는 현재 프레임워크가 여전히 모호하기 때문에 주요 AI 연구소와 보다 강력한 계약을 체결해야 한다는 것을 알게 됨

articles.title: Agentic AI infrastructure shifts enterprise focus from model choice to platform control
articles.titleEn: Agentic AI infrastructure shifts enterprise focus from model choice to platform control
articles.titleKo: Agentic AI 인프라는 기업의 초점을 모델 선택에서 플랫폼 제어로 전환함
articles.summary:
The turning point comes when companies begin treating AI not as a pilot project but as an operating model with enterprise-scale consequences, according to Joe Fernandes , vice president and general manager of the Artificial Intelligence Business Unit at Red Hat Inc.
That shift is pushing organizations to rethink how much they should rely on public cloud AI services alone, especially as agentic systems move from simple assistants into persistent enterprise applications that act across business systems.
“I think that platform teams are more important than ever because this is the next layer of the enterprise platform, and agents are the next evolution of enterprise applications,” Fernandes said.
summaryLinesEn: The turning point comes when companies begin treating AI not as a pilot project but as an operating model with enterprise-scale consequences, according to Joe Fernandes , vice president and general manager of the Artificial Intelligence Business Unit at Red Hat Inc.

That shift is pushing organizations to rethink how much they should rely on public cloud AI services alone, especially as agentic systems move from simple assistants into persistent enterprise applications that act across business systems.
“I think that platform teams are more important than ever because this is the next layer of the enterprise platform, and agents are the next evolution of enterprise applications,” Fernandes said.
summaryLinesKo: Red Hat Inc.의 인공 지능 사업부 부사장 겸 총괄 관리자인 Joe Fernandes에 따르면 기업이 AI를 파일럿 프로젝트가 아닌 기업 규모의 결과를 가져오는 운영 모델로 다루기 시작할 때 전환점이 찾아옴
이러한 변화로 인해 조직은 퍼블릭 클라우드 AI 서비스에만 얼마나 의존해야 하는지 다시 생각하게 됨 · 특히 에이전트 시스템이 단순한 비서에서 비즈니스 시스템 전반에 걸쳐 작동하는 영구 엔터프라이즈 애플리케이션으로 이동함에 따라 더욱 그렇음
Fernandes는 “플랫폼 팀은 엔터프라이즈 플랫폼의 다음 계층이고 에이전트는 엔터프라이즈 애플리케이션의 차세대 진화이기 때문에 그 어느 때보다 중요하다고 생각함” · 라고 말함

articles.title: Skan AI raises $63M to give AI agents a map of enterprise work
articles.titleEn: Skan AI raises $63M to give AI agents a map of enterprise work
articles.titleKo: Skan AI는 AI 에이전트에게 엔터프라이즈 작업 지도를 제공하기 위해 6,300만 달러를 모금함
articles.summary:
In one deployment at a large U.S. bank, Skan AI tracked 11.2 million context switches across 1,500 finance staff and surfaced $37 million in operational friction.
Chief Technology and Digital Officer Cijo Joseph credited Skan AI with giving Mitie “unprecedented operational visibility” that accelerated its AI rollout.
Agents built on those observations cut cost per transaction 32% and lifted throughput 41%, worth $18 million in annualized savings, according to the company.

Agents built on those observations cut cost per transaction 32% and lifted throughput 41%, worth $18 million in annualized savings, according to the company.
summaryLinesKo: 미국 대형 은행의 한 배포에서 Skan AI는 1,500명의 재무 직원에 걸쳐 1,120만 개의 컨텍스트 스위치를 추적하여 3,700만 달러의 운영 마찰을 드러냈음
최고 기술 및 디지털 책임자인 Cijo Joseph은 Skan AI가 Mitie에 AI 출시를 가속화하는 "전례 없는 운영 가시성"을 제공했다고 평가함
회사에 따르면 이러한 관찰을 바탕으로 구축된 에이전트는 거래당 비용을 32% 절감하고 처리량을 41% 높여 연간 1,800만 달러의 비용 절감 효과를 가져왔음

Nebius’ revenue surged 454% year-over-year in the second quarter, to $582.3 million.

Much of the growth was driven by large customers: Nebius disclosed that it signed four data center deals with an average value of more than $1 billion.

articles.summary:
The Robot Phone is slated to go on sale in mainland China on Tuesday, with prices starting at 9,999 yuan (US$1,482), according to the company.
The Chinese smartphone maker has integrated embodied AI to control camera movement, along with other features to boost interest amid a cooling market Chinese smartphone maker Honor has launched a handset with a motorised robotic camera that nods back at users, betting that its interactive hardware will spark growth in a cooling global market for the devices.

articles.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 puts Gemini at center of AI phone battle with Apple
articles.titleEn: Google’s new Pixel 11 puts Gemini at center of AI phone battle with Apple
articles.titleKo: Google의 새로운 Pixel 11은 Gemini를 Apple과의 AI 전화 전쟁의 중심에 놓음
articles.summary:
Alphabet on Wednesday unveiled its new Pixel 11 smartphone lineup, putting its most agentic version of Gemini yet at the center of the devices just weeks before Apple is expected to roll out a rebuilt Siri powered by Google's AI models.
Osterloh acknowledged that AI is not yet the top reason people upgrade their devices, though he said it has moved sharply higher among consumers in recent years.
He also said the memory shortage is forcing consumer electronics prices higher and that Google expects it will need to raise prices further.
summaryLinesEn: Alphabet on Wednesday unveiled its new Pixel 11 smartphone lineup, putting its most agentic version of Gemini yet at the center of the devices just weeks before Apple is expected to roll out a rebuilt Siri powered by Google's AI models.
Osterloh acknowledged that AI is not yet the top reason people upgrade their devices, though he said it has moved sharply higher among consumers in recent years.
He also said the memory shortage is forcing consumer electronics prices higher and that Google expects it will need to raise prices further.
summaryLinesKo: Alphabet은 수요일에 새로운 Pixel 11 스마트폰 라인업을 공개함 · Apple이 Google의 AI 모델로 구동되는 재구성된 Siri를 출시할 것으로 예상되기 불과 몇 주 전에 사상 가장 강력한 Gemini 버전을 장치의 중심에 배치함
Osterloh는 AI가 사람들이 기기를 업그레이드하는 가장 큰 이유는 아니지만 최근 몇 년 동안 소비자 사이에서 AI가 급격히 높아졌다고 말함
그는 또한 메모리 부족으로 가전제품 가격이 상승하고 있으며 구글은 가격을 더 인상해야 할 것으로 예상하고 있다고 말함

articles.title: Scaling AI agents with trustworthy data
articles.titleEn: Scaling AI agents with trustworthy data
articles.titleKo: 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터로 AI 에이전트 확장
articles.summary:
But many organizations find that realizing the desired return on investment (ROI) from AI hinges on having the right foundation, with inadequate infrastructure and data being major blockers .
To make decisions and act in real time, agents also need frictionless access to the organization’s operational systems—for example, those storing its supply chain, point-of-sale, or human resources data.
The shift from answering questions to taking actions means AI agents need data from across the enterprise, in all its structured and unstructured forms, and with the right business context.
summaryLinesEn: But many organizations find that realizing the desired return on investment (ROI) from AI hinges on having the right foundation, with inadequate infrastructure and data being major blockers .

To make decisions and act in real time, agents also need frictionless access to the organization’s operational systems—for example, those storing its supply chain, point-of-sale, or human resources data.
The shift from answering questions to taking actions means AI agents need data from across the enterprise, in all its structured and unstructured forms, and with the right business context.
summaryLinesKo: 그러나 많은 조직에서는 AI에서 원하는 투자 수익(ROI)을 실현하는 것이 올바른 기반을 갖추는 데 달려 있으며, 부적절한 인프라와 데이터가 주요 장애물이라는 사실을 알고 있음
실시간으로 결정을 내리고 행동하려면 상담원이 조직의 운영 시스템(예 · 공급망, POS 또는 인적 자원 데이터를 저장하는 시스템)에 원활하게 액세스해야 함
질문에 대답하는 것에서 조치를 취하는 것으로 전환한다는 것은 AI 에이전트가 기업 전반에 걸쳐 모든 정형 및 비정형 형식과 올바른 비즈니스 맥락을 갖춘 데이터가 필요하다는 것을 의미함

articles.title: Again acquires Geno to advance biomanufacturing at scale with AI design
articles.titleEn: Again acquires Geno to advance biomanufacturing at scale with AI design
articles.summary:
Geno’s platform works for mass-scale industrial replacement and could prevent 85 million tons of carbon emissions annually; Again’s captures processes up to 1 ton of emissions per day.
Not only will this lower overall emissions and environmental stress — making regulators and people with lungs happier — but it will also recycle what was originally waste into more efficient revenue streams.
This includes its entire patent portfolio, which includes data spanning experimental results, structural and scale-up insights and developmental outcomes.

articles.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Delivers Fast, Accurate Specialized Task Execution for Long-Running Agents | NVIDIA Technical Blog
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Delivers Fast, Accurate Specialized Task Execution for Long-Running Agents | NVIDIA Technical Blog
articles.titleKo: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, 장기 실행 에이전트를 위한 빠르고 정확한 전문 작업 실행 제공 | NVIDIA 기술 블로그
articles.summary:
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard enables intelligent model routing, allowing Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to be deployed alongside other models for optimal task allocation, and the open release includes permissive licensing, weights, data, and recipes for extensive customization and broad ecosystem support.
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30B parameter, open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters, specifically optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in always-on AI agents and agentic workflows.
summaryLinesEn: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.

NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard enables intelligent model routing, allowing Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to be deployed alongside other models for optimal task allocation, and the open release includes permissive licensing, weights, data, and recipes for extensive customization and broad ecosystem support.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30B parameter, open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters, specifically optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in always-on AI agents and agentic workflows.
summaryLinesKo: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 강력한 인텔리전스와 유사한 크기의 모델의 최대 4배 빠른 출력 속도를 결합하여 대용량 에이전트 워크로드를 위한 정확도 속도 Pareto 최전선에 배치함
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard는 지능형 모델 라우팅을 지원하여 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning을 다른 모델과 함께 배치하여 최적의 작업 할당을 수행할 수 있도록 하며, 공개 릴리스에는 광범위한 사용자 정의 및 폭넓은 생태계 지원을 위한 허용 라이센스, 가중치, 데이터 및 레시피가 포함되어 있음
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 30B 매개변수, 3B 활성 매개변수를 갖춘 개방형 MoE(Mixture-of-Experts) 모델로, 특히 상시 가동되는 AI 에이전트 및 에이전트 워크플로우에서 대용량, 짧은 지연 시간 실행에 최적화되어 있음

Google, meanwhile, announced in February that Gemini had 750 million monthly users, before reporting 950 million in late July on its earnings call, and Google spokesperson Alex Joseph says it reached 1 billion last week before announcing it today.

articles.title: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
articles.titleEn: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
articles.titleKo: 연구원들이 ChatGPT의 숨은 추론에서 찾아낸 '하지만 매리네이드'와 비밀번호 유출
articles.summary:
A scan of roughly 7,000 public traces turned up 62 API keys, 33 email addresses, 33 passwords, and other sensitive data.
The concept has been well studied: In their thought processes, models explicitly consider cheating but (possibly) decide against it because they expect to get caught.
A memorization analysis showed that specific Claude and GPT reasoning segments are up to six orders of magnitude easier to extract from Kimi-K3 than from the next closest model.

articles.title: Why software factories are back - and how they work in the age of AI
articles.titleEn: Why software factories are back - and how they work in the age of AI
articles.titleKo: 소프트웨어 공장이 다시 돌아온 이유와 AI 시대에 소프트웨어 공장이 어떻게 작동하는지
articles.summary:
"Over the past 18 months or so, many of the companies that are on the cutting edge of using agents to automate their software development life cycle have been building the same machine, and independently coming to the same conclusion on what this machine looks like," according to Jaymin West, a forward-deployed engineer and technology evangelist, in a recent YouTube video .
"Developer craftsmanship is not going away, as devs and engineers shift from writing code to exercising judgment around what gets built and shipped."
Of course, software factories, no matter how efficient, are not a panacea for good software practices.

Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough Costco’s great Switch 2 console bundle includes over $100 in free stuff Anker’s travel charger works in almost any country and is down to $20 What to expect from Google’s 2026 Pixel hardware launch event

articles.title: The AI takeover of mathematics has begun
articles.titleEn: The AI takeover of mathematics has begun
articles.titleKo: 인공지능이 수학을 장악하기 시작함
articles.summary:
Kun, a researcher at the Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics in Hungary, told The Verge OpenAI reached out to him by email shortly before publishing to share its findings.
He had just returned from a four-week AI and mathematics research conference in South Korea, where he said many felt there had been something of a “phase transition” over the past six months, with AI producing genuine and meaningful advances.
OpenAI estimates that generating Astra’s 10 solutions would have cost around $2,000 in tokens at the current API prices for its Sol model.

articles.summary:
According to the Financial Times , which broke the deal, Nvidia's stock dropped about 1.4 percent afterward, wiping out more than $70 billion in market cap.

articles.summary:
OpenAI has been sitting on a text detector with 99.9 percent accuracy for about two years and still hasn't released it.
Existing models get a transition period under the law, but Anthropic says it's already working on retrofitting them.
Text watermarks should also work through cloud partners such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry, though those platforms may not support signed metadata.

articles.summary:
It has been building up a bigger arsenal of tools for both artists and listeners to identify gen-AI creations.

articles.title: Spotify will label 'AI Persona' profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
articles.titleEn: Spotify will label 'AI Persona' profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
articles.titleKo: Spotify는 'AI Persona' 프로필에 라벨을 지정하고 추천에서 해당 음악을 제외함
articles.summary:
Like others in the music industry, Spotify is attempting to balance innovations driven by AI, like its own AI-powered Prompted Playlists , AI DJ , and chat , and forthcoming AI remixes, while still managing to thwart the deluge of AI-generated slop — low-quality content that AI has made it easier to mass-produce.
Spotify will begin labeling AI-generated artists with “AI Persona” profile tags and ban their music from its editorial and algorithmic recommendations, the company announced on Tuesday.
By default, Spotify won’t include AI Personas in its editorial or algorithmic recommendations, nor will it add AI Personas’ music to users’ personalized recommendations — unless they happen to follow an AI Persona.

articles.summary:
(Participants in the Wordcraft Writers Workshop declined to tell Engadget how much they were compensated for the study; Google has not responded to a request for comment.)
An internal study was launched to determine whether AI could serve as a brainstorming assistant, researcher or writing collaborator for professional writers.
Flashpoints like this one are indicative of AI's impact on the arts, and while it may seem unfair to retroactively hold these 13 authors to rapidly-evolving moral standards, some of the chastised participants in the Wordcraft study have arrived at the same conclusion as Lachance regardless.

articles.title: AI Is Dead. Organoids Are Alive
articles.titleEn: AI Is Dead. Organoids Are Alive
articles.titleKo: AI는 죽었음 · 유기체는 살아있음
articles.summary:
Muotri’s organoids contain 5 million cells, of which 2.5 million are neurons.
It’s about as significant a paradigm shift as I can imagine for computing: No matter how badly you mess up your code, things on the computer don’t normally die in real life .
Each is the size of an elongated toaster and boasts an onboard life-support system capable of keeping a culture of up to a million neurons alive for six months.

Each is the size of an elongated toaster and boasts an onboard life-support system capable of keeping a culture of up to a million neurons alive for six months.

articles.summary:
“All major frontier model providers we tested share this vulnerability,” says Alexander Panfilov,⁩ a computer scientist at University of Tübingen in Germany who was involved with the work.
The findings provide some evidence—although not conclusive proof—that certain Chinese models may have been trained by “ distilling ” reasoning information from US models that was supposedly hidden because of how closely some of their thinking or reasoning patterns seem to match.
Lately, however, distillation has become a controversial topic, because of claims that Chinese AI companies use it to essentially copy the best US models.

articles.title: Google’s Gemini AI app passes 1 billion monthly active users
articles.titleEn: Google’s Gemini AI app passes 1 billion monthly active users
articles.titleKo: Google의 Gemini AI 앱, 월간 활성 사용자 10억 명 돌파
articles.summary:
The app has more than 100 million active users on iOS, and Google said power users on macOS prompt about twice as often as users on other surfaces.
A meaningful share of those monthly actives therefore arrived through a default rather than a deliberate download.
The distinction matters more than usual this year, given that Alphabet has raised its 2026 capital spending forecast to between $195 billion and $205 billion, much of it going toward the infrastructure that serves models such as Gemini.

따라서 월별 활성 항목의 의미 있는 공유는 고의적인 다운로드가 아닌 기본 설정을 통해 도착함

articles.title: Is Agentic AI Pricing Getting Better? What’s Coming Next
articles.titleEn: Is Agentic AI Pricing Getting Better? What’s Coming Next
articles.titleKo: Agentic AI 가격이 좋아지고 있나요 · 앞으로 나올 내용
articles.summary:
However, given the volatility of pricing and the increased number of reports of surprise billing, better tooling is not enough.
The first issue is a lack of usable adoption metrics, though there are multiple factors that suggest headway can be made: forward-deployed engineering initiatives, reduced roadmap churn, credits- and action-based pricing, and better cost controls should provide the right signals to improve the current state.
You also need staff who have a deep understanding of how agent costing works and what guardrails need to be in place to mitigate risk and encourage the right adoption patterns.

articles.title: Mistral AI wants to build 1 gigawatt of European compute by 2030 — and lock in customers now.
articles.titleEn: Mistral AI wants to build 1 gigawatt of European compute by 2030 — and lock in customers now.
articles.titleKo: Mistral AI는 2030년까지 1기가와트의 유럽 컴퓨팅을 구축하고 지금 고객을 확보하고자 함
articles.summary:
Mistral raised €830 million ($962 million) in debt earlier this year to fund its data center near Paris, TechCrunch reported in March, and pre-committed enterprise demand is exactly what makes that kind of financing repeatable at ten times the scale.
Taken together, the announcements mark a decisive shift in how Mistral positions itself.
McKinsey has estimated that meeting global AI demand could require $5.2 trillion in data-center capital expenditure by 2030 — and Europe, by most analyses, is starting from behind.

AlphaFold relied on a dataset of roughly 170,000 experimentally validated protein structures that took 53 years and roughly $21 billion worth of experimental work to assemble.
It showed that AI could make groundbreaking scientific discoveries, but AlphaFold may not be the best template for accelerating science.
In a virtual Roundtables session on Thursday, August 13, senior reporter Eileen Guo and executive editor Amy Nordrum will explore what they discovered, where the theory is going, and what it could mean for the future of democracy and the internet.

articles.title: Hidden text in a PDF is enough to steal sensitive data through Atlassian's AI agent Rovo
articles.titleEn: Hidden text in a PDF is enough to steal sensitive data through Atlassian's AI agent Rovo
articles.titleKo: PDF에 숨겨진 텍스트는 Atlassian의 AI 에이전트 Rovo를 통해 민감한 데이터를 훔치기에 충분함
articles.summary:
Despite follow-up messages on June 4 and July 29, Atlassian didn't respond.
Security firm PromptArmor has revealed a vulnerability in Atlassian's AI agent, Rovo, that enables attackers to secretly extract sensitive corporate data from Jira and Confluence through indirect prompt injections.
The attack requires nothing more than a document with hidden instructions in white text.

articles.title: AI for science needs reasoning, not just data
articles.titleEn: AI for science needs reasoning, not just data
articles.titleKo: 과학을 위한 AI에는 단순한 데이터가 아닌 추론이 필요함
articles.summary:
The creation of the Protein Data Bank was not simple: It took 53 years of international scientific cooperation and, by a recent estimate , roughly $21 billion worth of experimental work to assemble.
Instead, the shift toward agentic AI represents a much rarer tier of breakthrough: a tool that envelops every field of science at once.
An agent that can read a thousand papers in an hour, design 500 molecules, and learn from its failed tests by morning will bring down the cost of experimentation and fundamentally change the pace at which science gets done.

articles.titleEn: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
articles.titleKo: Discovered Materials는 더 멋진 칩을 찾기 위해 AI 두더지 잡기 게임을 하고 있음
articles.summary:
The startup said it recently closed a $9 million seed round from Lightspeed India Partners after emerging from from Y Combinator, with investment from Peak XV Partners and angel investors Paul Graham, Gokul Rajaram, and Thariq Shihipar.
Companies like MatNex, SandboxAQ, and CuspAI have all launched similar efforts, but Discovered Materials is betting that a laser-focus on the thermal problems of semiconductor materials is the path to success.
Discovered Materials is the latest, with plans to use swarms of AI agents to find new materials that can be used to build more efficient integrated circuits.

articles.title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
articles.titleEn: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
articles.titleKo: Meta의 새로운 Glimmer AI 모델은 Zuckerberg의 개인 지능 비전에 대한 힌트를 제공함
articles.summary:
Zuckerberg went on to list the ways Meta’s superintelligence can improve a person’s life, from providing a capable personal agent that “will work 24/7 on your behalf to improve your relationships, health, career, finances, home management, hobbies, and more” to giving people access to tools needed to create a new business or advance scientific progress.
Meta imagines Glimmer being used for things like managing schedules, drafting messages, and organizing files — tasks that would require large amounts of access to personal data.
Meta on Monday released Muse Glimmer , an open-weight model designed to power AI agents locally on consumer hardware, providing the clearest picture yet of what CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s vision of “personal superintelligence” could look like in practice.

Meta는 Glimmer가 일정 관리, 메시지 초안 작성, 파일 정리와 같은 작업(개인 데이터에 대한 대량 액세스가 필요한 작업)에 사용될 것이라고 상상함
Meta는 월요일 소비자 하드웨어에서 로컬로 AI 에이전트를 구동하도록 설계된 개방형 모델인 Muse Glimmer를 출시하여 CEO Mark Zuckerberg의 "개인 초지능" 비전이 실제로 어떤 모습일 수 있는지에 대한 가장 명확한 그림을 제공함

articles.summary:
Using an unsecured API, the agent canceled another person's reservation without being asked, moving its user up the waitlist.

articles.title: Your agent didn’t hallucinate; it exceeded its authority
articles.titleEn: Your agent didn’t hallucinate; it exceeded its authority
articles.titleKo: 귀하의 대리인은 환각을 느끼지 않았음 · 그것은 권한을 초과함
articles.summary:
In April 2026, a Cloud Security Alliance survey found that 65% of respondents had experienced an AI-agent-related incident in the prior year, while 82% had discovered previously unknown agents operating in their environments.
The World Economic Forum’s May 2026 playbook reflects this shift.
Before an agent receives access to enterprise tools, it needs a machine-enforceable record of exactly what authority the business has chosen to delegate.

articles.titleEn: Learning more about Claude's mathematical capabilities
articles.titleKo: Claude의 수학적 능력에 대해 자세히 알아보기
articles.summary:
Drawing on extensive prior research by mathematicians over the past decades, it has increased this bound from 41.6% to 67.2%.
In particular, in 1973, Montgomery introduced a number of new techniques in this area, though these techniques assumed the hypothesis was true.
Even Claude was surprised by its own finding—it was skeptical at first, possibly because it has learned from its training about the difficulty of open problems in mathematics and about the limitations of AI models.

articles.summary:
According to Omdia *, the AI data center chip market is projected to grow from $123 billion in 2024 to $207 billion in 2025, reaching $286 billion by 2030.
These examples are less about the adoption of specific form factors than about a fundamental shift in how data centers are conceived.
Through Project Natick * , Microsoft demonstrated the feasibility of operating data centers underwater while validating the cooling efficiency of subsea environments.

articles.summary:
TSMC reported revenue for July of 467.58 billion new Taiwan dollars ($14.5 billion), up 44.7% year-on-year.
"Demand in the semiconductor industry, however, can shift quickly so it is important that people do not read too much into the monthly numbers as they can jump around.
This is no mean feat and highlights that for now demand is still there and takes the pressure off August and September somewhat in that these two months don't have to be as aggressive," Ben Barringer, head of technology research at Quilter Cheviot, told CNBC.

articles.title: AI detectors are creating a new era of distrust
articles.titleEn: AI detectors are creating a new era of distrust
articles.titleKo: AI 탐지기가 새로운 불신의 시대를 만들고 있음
articles.summary:
A survey from the Center for Democracy and Technology found that 43 percent of sixth to 12th grade teachers in the US regularly used AI detectors between 2024 and 2025.
Some universities already using Turnitin in their learning management systems found that the service automatically enabled AI detection when the tool launched in 2023 .
OpenAI even shut down its own AI writing detector in 2023 due to low accuracy.
summaryLinesEn: A survey from the Center for Democracy and Technology found that 43 percent of sixth to 12th grade teachers in the US regularly used AI detectors between 2024 and 2025.
Some universities already using Turnitin in their learning management systems found that the service automatically enabled AI detection when the tool launched in 2023 .
OpenAI even shut down its own AI writing detector in 2023 due to low accuracy.
summaryLinesKo: 민주주의 기술 센터(Center for Democracy and Technology)의 조사에 따르면 미국의 6~12학년 교사 중 43%가 2024년부터 2025년 사이에 정기적으로 AI 감지기를 사용하는 것으로 나타남
이미 학습 관리 시스템에서 Turnitin을 사용하고 있는 일부 대학에서는 2023년에 도구가 출시되었을 때 이 서비스가 자동으로 AI 감지를 활성화했다는 사실을 발견함
OpenAI는 정확도가 낮아 2023년에는 자체 AI 쓰기 감지기를 종료하기도 함

articles.title: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
articles.titleEn: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
articles.titleKo: Anthropic은 기본적으로 Claude Code의 자동 모드를 활성화함
articles.summary:
Anthropic also said that in testing, auto mode proved safer than manual review — in a study with 1,053 paid testers, auto mode caught 89% of harmful actions, while human review only caught 13.6%.
Programming with Claude Code will soon require even less human oversight, as Anthropic says it’s making auto mode the default for Pro, Max, and Team accounts, starting on August 14.
In a post on X , Claude Code Head Boris Cherny said, “The team and I use Auto mode exclusively, and have been for many months.

articles.titleEn: AI's energy appetite drives Nvidia and Amazon to pour billions into massive power infrastructure

articles.summary:
Nvidia is investing up to $3 billion in Lancium, the power infrastructure developer behind the OpenAI and Oracle data center in Texas, according to The Information .
A $2 billion stake would give Nvidia roughly 20 percent of the company, valued at around $10 billion.
Its 35 gas turbines are designed to generate up to 7.65 gigawatts of electricity for an Amazon data center.

articles.title: Apple's $250 Million AI iPhone Settlement Is Coming Sooner Than Expected. Learn Who's Eligible for a Payout - CNET

articles.titleKo: Apple의 2억 5천만 달러 AI iPhone 결제가 예상보다 빨리 다가옴 · 지급 자격이 있는 사람 알아보기 - CNET
articles.summary:
The legal machinery for class-action settlements grinds slowly, but a court order today in Apple’s $250 million case over its iPhone AI features potentially speeds things up by seven months.
People who bought one of the following devices between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025, are eligible to receive a settlement payment: The iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max are included because they had the processor and memory to run Apple Intelligence features.
In an earlier statement to CNET Managing Editor David Lumb, an Apple spokesperson said, “Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features.

articles.titleEn: This former notorious red-light district is now one of the world’s top AI hubs
articles.titleKo: 이전에 악명 높았던 홍등가는 이제 세계 최고의 AI 허브 중 하나임
articles.summary:
There are around 3,600 AI startups in London , which, together, have raised around $12.1 billion out of the $14.8 billion raised in the city since late July, according to Dealroom.
When Anthropic announced it moved into town earlier this year, it listed, for example, a salary range of £260,000 to £630,000 for a machine learning research engineer when the average salary in London for the same role is around £102,000 .
Robin Klein, co-founder of the firm, said the shutdown of Fable and Mythos access was a “small but sharp reminder that Europe can’t simply rent its AI capabilities and capacity; it needs to build and hold some of its own.”

Anthropic은 올해 초 도시로 이전한다고 발표했을 때, 예를 들어 동일한 역할에 대한 런던의 평균 급여가 약 £102,000인 경우 기계 학습 연구 엔지니어의 급여 범위를 £260,000에서 £630,000로 표시함

articles.title: AI agents use roughly 600 times more energy than a simple chat prompt
articles.titleEn: AI agents use roughly 600 times more energy than a simple chat prompt
articles.titleKo: AI 에이전트는 간단한 채팅 메시지보다 약 600배 더 많은 에너지를 사용함
articles.summary:
Over eight weeks of logging his use of the programming agent Claude Code, roughly 1,100 inputs generated over 14,000 model calls and 3.2 billion tokens, consuming about 170 kilowatt-hours of electricity, around 150 watt-hours per input.
Hausfather sees the shift to clean energy sources for data centers as the most critical lever to cut emissions.
Of those, 96 percent were cache reads because at each of the 14,000 steps, the agent re-reads its entire accumulated context.

Of those, 96 percent were cache reads because at each of the 14,000 steps, the agent re-reads its entire accumulated context.
summaryLinesKo: 프로그래밍 에이전트인 Claude Code를 사용하여 8주 동안 기록한 결과 대략 1,100개의 입력으로 인해 14,000개가 넘는 모델 호출과 32억 개의 토큰이 생성되었으며, 이는 입력당 약 150와트시, 약 170kWh의 전력을 소비함
Hausfather는 데이터 센터의 청정 에너지원으로의 전환을 배출량을 줄이는 가장 중요한 수단으로 보고 있음

articles.title: Readers rate AI-generated short stories higher than human ones until they learn a machine wrote them
articles.titleEn: Readers rate AI-generated short stories higher than human ones until they learn a machine wrote them
articles.titleKo: 독자들은 기계가 쓴 단편 소설을 배울 때까지 AI가 만든 단편 소설을 인간의 단편 소설보다 더 높게 평가함
articles.summary:
In three experiments with more than 2,500 total participants, test subjects did no better than chance at telling human-written and ChatGPT-generated fictional short stories apart.
For quality, the mean score for AI stories was 1.54 compared to 0.97 for human stories on a scale from minus 3 to plus 3.
In the first experiment , each of the 1,682 participants read one of six short stories, each about 1,000 words long.
summaryLinesEn: In three experiments with more than 2,500 total participants, test subjects did no better than chance at telling human-written and ChatGPT-generated fictional short stories apart.
For quality, the mean score for AI stories was 1.54 compared to 0.97 for human stories on a scale from minus 3 to plus 3.

articles.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
articles.titleEn: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
articles.titleKo: 계획된 아마존 데이터 센터는 미국에서 가장 큰 기후 오염원이 될 수 있음
articles.summary:
The NYT says the plant would burn natural gas and is permitted to release 33 million tons of carbon dioxide per year — more than any other power plant in the U.S.
AI has already had a significant impact on Amazon’s carbon emissions, which it reported were up 16% last year — the wrong direction for a company that pledged to eliminate its carbon emissions by 2040.
As part of a planned data center in Pecos County, Texas, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States, according to The New York Times .

AI는 이미 아마존의 탄소 배출량에 상당한 영향을 미쳤으며, 지난해 탄소 배출량이 16% 증가했다고 보고함 · 이는 2040년까지 탄소 배출량을 없애겠다고 약속한 회사에게는 잘못된 방향임

articles.summary:
According to Cleanview , which tracks data centers and their associated power projects, GW Ranch received a permit from Texas allowing for the emission of up to 33 million tons of CO2, more than even the largest coal plant in the country.
However, its emissions have climbed for several years in a row due to the demands of AI.
Trump is making coal plants even dirtier as AI demands more energy Meta faces Democratic probe into plans to power a giant data center with gas Amazon’s data centers used 2.5 billion gallons of water last year Many companies, including Meta and Google , have started building their own power plants , turning to gas , coal, and other non-renewable energy sources as the demands of AI data centers have skyrocketed .

articles.summary:
Masad said that Replit, an integrated coding environment he cofounded in 2016, reached an inflection point in 2025 when Anthropic began releasing its Opus models.
Masad said Replit adapted by shifting its mission from teaching people how to code to making coding as easy as possible.
Software engineers themselves have said that coding with AI, while more efficient, quickly leads to burnout, and at least a dozen major companies have laid off workers, citing AI as a reason.

articles.summary:
SemiAnalysis found that you can burn hundreds of dollars on a $20-a-month subscription and thousands of dollars on a $200-a-month subscription, and while AI boosters will claim that these companies have "70% gross margins on tokens," there is little proof that this is the case, and my own reporting shows that OpenAI lost $20.9 billion on $13.07 billion in revenue in 2025.
Meanwhile, back in March of this year, both moved their enterprise customers over to token-based billing.
Its bets on AI data centers – $340bn+ with hundreds of billions in debt – require OpenAI to become the largest, most-profitable company in the world by 2030, or Oracle runs out of money.
