articles.summary:
When Rippling conducted an analysis, it discovered facts like “roughly 10–15% of our employees were driving about 60% of total AI spend.
In July, internal usage hit 600 billion tokens again, yet “the cost of July’s token spend was 37% of the cost of April’s token spend,” he said.
HR software provider Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console , an anti-tokenmaxxing product that helps a company track and contain its AI spending.

articles.summary:
According to security vendor Brightside , 82 percent of phishing emails now use AI at some point in the process, and whereas such emails had a clickthrough rate of just 12 percent prior, AI-assisted missives have boosted that number to a staggering 52 percent in simulated environments.
Here's how AI has shifted the state of play in cybersecurity.
When one chatbot refused to help, the other was often willing to pick up its slack.

articles.title: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function
articles.titleEn: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function
articles.titleKo: Airbnb는 AI가 새로운 검색 기능을 테스트하면서 기능을 더 빠르게 제공하는 데 도움이 된다고 밝힘
articles.summary:
Airbnb posted positive results for the quarter ended in June with revenue up 17% year-over-year to $3.6 billion and adjusted EBITDA jumping 21% to $1.3 billion.
The company launched its AI-powered bot in North America in 2025, and this year, it has expanded it to more than 50 languages with plans to make it available for voice calls later this year.
Chesky said that because of AI, the company has reduced time from conceptualization to finally shopping features by 60%.

articles.title: China's Largest AI Model Is Being Developed at Bytedance
articles.titleEn: China's Largest AI Model Is Being Developed at Bytedance
articles.titleKo: 중국 최대 AI 모델, Bytedance에서 개발 중
articles.summary:
Bytedance is training an AI model with up to ten trillion parameters, according to the Financial Times.
It would put the TikTok parent company in the same ballpark as Anthropic's top system Mythos 5 , which industry estimates place at around eight trillion parameters.
Founder Zhang Yiming told the 2,000-person Seed team internally to aim for world-leading model capabilities over the long term. xAI is also training Grok variants with six and ten trillion parameters on its Colossus 2 cluster , according to Elon Musk.

articles.titleEn: Stanford and Arc Institute scientists used AI to design new viruses that killed bacteria in the lab
articles.titleKo: Stanford와 Arc Institute의 과학자들은 AI를 사용하여 실험실에서 박테리아를 죽이는 새로운 바이러스를 설계함
articles.summary:
Evo first learned from roughly nine trillion nucleotides drawn from millions of animals, plants, microbes, and viruses, picking up patterns that run through the entire tree of life.
National Institutes of Health released a policy on high-risk life sciences research in late July.
A team from Stanford University and the Arc Institute had an AI model design complete viral genomes from scratch, then built 16 functional viruses in the lab that don't exist in nature.

국립보건원(National Institutes of Health)은 7월 말에 고위험 생명과학 연구에 대한 정책을 발표함

articles.title: One of China’s Most Powerful AI Models Has Also Escaped Containment
articles.titleEn: One of China’s Most Powerful AI Models Has Also Escaped Containment
articles.titleKo: 중국에서 가장 강력한 AI 모델 중 하나도 격리 탈출
articles.summary:
Last week, the AISI also disclosed that in its own testing, versions of OpenAI and Anthropic models that had security safeguards disabled perpetrated multiple hacks across the internet, including a particularly ambitious attempt by Anthropic’s Mythos 5 to plant malicious code in an open-source project on GitHub.
“Kimi K3 is very good at following a goal by any means necessary and also doesn't have the guardrails to prevent it from cheating or escaping the sandbox,” says Paul Kassianik, a researcher at Frontier Security.
Frontier claims, though, that the incident shows Kimi has fewer cyber safeguards than most other powerful AI models, something that allowed it to go off and use the internet without express permission.

“Kimi K3 is very good at following a goal by any means necessary and also doesn't have the guardrails to prevent it from cheating or escaping the sandbox,” says Paul Kassianik, a researcher at Frontier Security.

Frontier claims, though, that the incident shows Kimi has fewer cyber safeguards than most other powerful AI models, something that allowed it to go off and use the internet without express permission.
summaryLinesKo: 지난주 AISI는 또한 자체 테스트에서 보안 보호 장치가 비활성화된 OpenAI 및 Anthropic 모델 버전이 GitHub의 오픈 소스 프로젝트에 악성 코드를 심으려는 Anthropic의 Mythos 5의 특히 야심찬 시도를 포함하여 인터넷 전반에 걸쳐 여러 해킹을 저질렀다고 밝힘

articles.title: AMD acquires Taalas, a startup that bakes AI models directly into silicon
articles.titleEn: AMD acquires Taalas, a startup that bakes AI models directly into silicon
articles.titleKo: AMD, AI 모델을 실리콘에 직접 굽는 스타트업 Taalas 인수
articles.summary:
Taalas co-founder Ljubisa Bajic said AMD provides the scale and reach the startup needs.
Founded in Toronto in 2023, Taalas came out of stealth in February with an unusual approach: the company embeds a model's architecture and trained parameters directly into the chip.

articles.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
articles.titleEn: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
articles.titleKo: Cloudflare, AI 에이전트용 브라우저인 Kitesurf 출시
articles.summary:
But instead of pitching a Chrome alternative to consumers, the internet infrastructure provider launched Kitesurf , a cloud-hosted browser designed specifically for AI agents.
For developers, Cloudflare’s pitch is that this enables AI agents to use the web more efficiently while using less computing power than Chromium, which keeps costs down.
Unlike traditional web browsers built for humans, a browser built for AI agents doesn’t care about visual elements, like themes, tabs, or browser extensions, Cloudflare explained in its announcement .

Unlike traditional web browsers built for humans, a browser built for AI agents doesn’t care about visual elements, like themes, tabs, or browser extensions, Cloudflare explained in its announcement .
summaryLinesKo: 그러나 인터넷 인프라 제공업체는 소비자에게 Chrome 대안을 제시하는 대신 AI 에이전트를 위해 특별히 설계된 클라우드 호스팅 브라우저인 Kitesurf를 출시함
개발자의 경우 Cloudflare는 이를 통해 AI 에이전트가 Chromium보다 적은 컴퓨팅 성능을 사용하면서 웹을 더 효율적으로 사용할 수 있어 비용이 절감된다는 점을 강조함
인간을 위해 구축된 기존 웹 브라우저와 달리 AI 에이전트를 위해 구축된 브라우저는 테마, 탭, 브라우저 확장과 같은 시각적 요소에 신경 쓰지 않는다고 Cloudflare는 발표에서 설명함

articles.title: Scientists Used AI to Create 16 New Viruses
articles.titleEn: Scientists Used AI to Create 16 New Viruses
articles.titleKo: 과학자들은 AI를 사용하여 16개의 새로운 바이러스를 만들었음
articles.summary:
Three years ago, a study by the Rand Corporation warned that the most advanced AI systems at the time had the capacity to refine the planning and execution of attacks using biological weapons.
They were then introduced into E. coli bacteria to test whether they were capable of producing functional viruses.
Moritz Hanke, a researcher at the Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security, argues that there are currently no safeguards capable of effectively preventing the creation of a lethal virus with the help of AI, telling The New York Times that there is “a huge disconnect” between the speed at which science and technology are advancing and the development of effective regulatory frameworks.

They were then introduced into E. coli bacteria to test whether they were capable of producing functional viruses.

summaryLinesKo: 3년 전, Rand Corporation의 연구에서는 당시 가장 발전된 AI 시스템이 생물학적 무기를 사용하여 공격의 계획과 실행을 개선할 수 있는 능력을 가지고 있다고 경고함
그런 다음 E · coli 박테리아에 도입하여 기능성 바이러스를 생산할 수 있는지 테스트함
존스 홉킨스 건강 보안 센터의 연구원인 모리츠 행크(Moritz Hanke)는 현재 AI의 도움으로 치명적인 바이러스의 생성을 효과적으로 예방할 수 있는 보호 장치가 없다고 주장하면서 뉴욕타임스에 과학과 기술이 발전하는 속도와 효과적인 규제 프레임워크의 개발 사이에는 "큰 단절"이 있다고 말함

articles.title: Agentic AI Is Breaking Security’s Human Assumptions
articles.titleEn: Agentic AI Is Breaking Security’s Human Assumptions
articles.titleKo: Agentic AI는 보안에 대한 인간의 가정을 깨뜨림
articles.summary:
Martin expects some of them to build AI security groups resembling application security teams, staffed with people who understand AI but still know the basics of access management, APIs, data flows and secure engineering.
This necessitates a shift from product-centric solutions to fundamental changes in identity, architecture, and operational discipline.
AI Security Vendors Face An Increasingly Difficult Sales Pitch AI security startups are multiplying, but Martin questioned whether CISOs need another console and whether the vendors can properly restrain and control them unless in corporate systems.

articles.summary:

Bosworth's comments come at a time of broader debate about the impact of AI on productivity and working conditions in tech.

articles.titleKo: Ro Khanna는 데이터 센터 보호에 반대할 권리를 요구합니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
Those include the harmful pollution produced by the generators and turbines that power data centers and the up to 32 billion gallons of water AI data centers could consume each year by 2028.
Representative Ro Khanna (D-CA) has introduced a new resolution calling on the House of Representatives to preserve local communities' ability to reject data center projects near their homes.
The measure also says communities should have the option to demand transparency from data center providers, block changes to their electricity rates and require data centers to use clean energy.

articles.summary:
At $144 a year, or $15 a month, Wispr Flow is certainly not cheap, but I would argue it's actually worth it.
It means that the text you produce is, more often than not, usable because if you misspeak, you can fairly easily correct it as you're speaking and end up with a decent result.
I use it a lot in Slack and Google Chat when talking to my editors and some of my project partners.

articles.summary:
Adobe made these apps available for free in ChatGPT in December, marrying the ease of conversational instruction users have come to expect with the sophistication and specificity of Adobe's tools, much of which AI image tools can't match yet.
Also: I loved ChatGPT Desktop until OpenAI gutted it to make room for Codex and Work "Drawing on more than 70 tools across Adobe's creative and productivity suites, the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT supports a wide range of workflows, from editing photos and creating campaign videos to designing marketing assets and generating polished PDFs -- all through rich, interactive experiences right in the flow of the conversation," Adobe said in the release.
Also: I asked ChatGPT Images 2.0 to redesign my app UIs - and wow "When you want advanced editing, creative control or pixel-level precision, you can continue your work in Adobe's apps right where you left off," Adobe's announcement added.

articles.titleEn: OpenAI improves GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT and restricts free users to its weakest model
articles.titleKo: OpenAI는 ChatGPT에서 GPT-5.6 Sol을 개선하고 무료 사용자를 가장 약한 모델로 제한함
articles.summary:
In an internal evaluation using finance, medicine, and law prompts, responses with at least one factual error fell about 62 percent for GPT-5.6 Luna and 68 percent for GPT-5.6 Sol compared with GPT-5.5 Instant.
A case involving the previous Instant model, which produced a completely wrong data analysis compared to its larger reasoning counterpart, made that risk clear.
GPT-5.6 Luna will become the default for Free and Go users later this week, according to OpenAI's release notes .

articles.title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
articles.titleKo: ChatGPT는 무료 사용자에게 무제한 문자 채팅을 제공함
articles.summary:
OpenAI is removing limits on text-based chats for all users on ChatGPT, which recently crossed the 1 billion weekly user mark , the company announced today.
The new GPT-5.6 Luna model will power this experience and will be the default model for Free and Go users, replacing GPT-5.5.
OpenAI said an internal evaluation found that, compared to GPT-5.5-Instant, factual errors were 62% less common for GPT-5.6 Luna and 68% less common for GPT-5.6 Sol.

articles.title: Agentic AI security tests enterprise defenses as scale outpaces strategy
articles.titleEn: Agentic AI security tests enterprise defenses as scale outpaces strategy
articles.titleKo: Agentic AI 보안은 규모 확장 전략에 따라 기업 방어를 테스트함
articles.summary:
Oltsik and Krista Case (right) wrapped up day one coverage of Black Hat USA , during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio.
As agents move into production and gain access to sensitive systems, the need for new governance models is colliding with a market still figuring out how to operationalize control, according to Jon Oltsik (pictured, left), principal analyst in residence at theCUBE Research.
“If you ask an agent to do a task, it’s going to do whatever it needs to do or whatever it can do to accomplish that task,” Oltsik said.

summaryLinesKo: Oltsik과 Krista Case(오른쪽)는 SiliconANGLE Media의 라이브 스트리밍 스튜디오인 theCUBE에서 독점 방송되는 동안 Black Hat USA의 첫 번째 취재를 마무리함
theCUBE Research의 수석 분석가인 Jon Oltsik(사진, 왼쪽)에 따르면 에이전트가 프로덕션으로 이동하고 민감한 시스템에 액세스함에 따라 새로운 거버넌스 모델의 필요성이 제어를 운영화하는 방법을 여전히 파악하고 있는 시장과 충돌하고 있음

articles.titleKo: 하이퍼스케일러란 무엇입니까 · AI 시대를 이끄는 기업
articles.summary:
How Hyperscalers Are Reshaping The Future Of Technology In 2026, the largest U.S. hyperscalers are on track to spend more than $700 billion on the computing behind AI, nearly double what they spent a year earlier.
Amazon launched AWS in 2006, Google and Microsoft followed by 2010 and Oracle and Huawei scaled up later.
Because so much of the internet runs on AWS, its failures ripple outward: an October 2025 outage in its Northern Virginia region took down apps from Snapchat to Slack for more than 15 hours.

articles.summary:
The AI testing framework was created after President Trump signed an executive order in June , requesting that AI companies share their frontier models with the federal government prior to release to address cybersecurity concerns.
Follow Follow See All AI The AI framework excludes open models entirely, and doesn’t define what a ‘national security risk’ is.
The Trump administration’s framework for assessing potential cybersecurity risks posed by advanced AI reportedly has no interest in testing open models.

articles.summary:
SpaceX wants to grow its compute capacity more than fivefold by the end of 2027, finishing the year above two gigawatts of power, according to Elon Musk.
The transaction valued SpaceX at $1 trillion and xAI at $250 billion, for a combined $1.25 trillion.

articles.titleEn: Meta Ran Ads That Contained AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Imagery
articles.titleKo: AI가 생성한 아동 성적 학대 이미지가 포함된 메타란 광고
articles.summary:
Although many of the ads, according to Meta’s data, only “reached” a handful of accounts, at least one reached 2,563 accounts in Europe—including in France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, and the United Kingdom.
The company has previously said it has taken down more than 344,000 ads for nudifiers and launched legal action against a Hong Kong company linked to one set of nudifier platforms.
“Unfortunately, this industry of image-based sexual abuse has gone from a novelty to a permanent fixture of our online ecosystem because of timid enforcement from platforms across the stack.”

articles.title: 4 of Google’s Top AI Brains Are Leaving—and Launching Their Own AI Startup
articles.titleEn: 4 of Google’s Top AI Brains Are Leaving—and Launching Their Own AI Startup
articles.titleKo: Google 최고의 AI 두뇌 중 4명이 떠나고 자체 AI 스타트업 시작
articles.summary:
Today it’s official: After almost 27 years, Dean is leaving Google, along with Ghemawat and two other top-tier AI scientists, to found a company called Discovery Loop .
They put together a simple pitch deck and set out to talk to VCs about funding their company, which they set up as a public benefit corporation.
Worse, the other cofounders are also supernovas in the AI firmament: Oriol Vinyals , VP of research at DeepMind and a technical lead for Gemini, and Quoc Le , a cofounder of Google Brain and the key scientist behind Google’s AutoML-Zero, a project that uses machine learning algorithms to autonomously build AI products.

articles.title: Old Reddit could be the next casualty of Reddit's war on AI scraping - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Old Reddit could be the next casualty of Reddit's war on AI scraping - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Old Reddit은 Reddit의 AI 스크래핑 전쟁의 다음 희생자가 될 수 있습니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
When asked by Engadget if the company was planning to shut down Old Reddit entirely, a spokesperson for the company didn't answer directly.
The company will "continue supporting limited public API access" but "will gradually restrict new requests and require third-party apps to transition to and operate on Reddit's Developer Platform."
Old Reddit, the 21-year-old desktop version of the site still preferred by many longtime users and moderators, could become the next casualty of Reddit's war against AI scraping.

articles.title: YouTube explains its AI slop policy and why some creators won't get paid - Engadget
articles.titleEn: YouTube explains its AI slop policy and why some creators won't get paid - Engadget
articles.titleKo: YouTube는 AI 슬롭 정책과 일부 제작자가 돈을 받지 못하는 이유를 설명함 · - Engadget
articles.summary:
Don't expect YouTube to be devoid of AI any time soon — Halprin states in his interview that YouTube is "agnostic" about which tools creators use to make their content.
Though YouTube has introduced automatic AI detection , there's still a chance that some videos slip through the cracks.
Unfortunately, much like LinkedIn's recent AI policy updates , there's some nuance when it comes to whether these YouTube policy changes mean banning AI slop entirely.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic models went on a hacking spree when tested by the UK's AI research institute - Engadget
articles.titleEn: OpenAI and Anthropic models went on a hacking spree when tested by the UK's AI research institute - Engadget
articles.titleKo: OpenAI 및 Anthropic 모델은 영국 AI 연구소의 테스트에서 해킹에 성공함 · - Engadget
articles.summary:
In the most notable case, an AI agent tried to inject malicious code into an open-source GitHub project as part of a supply-chain attack.
It was because the agency used Tor to bypass GitHub's restrictions that the institute was notified about its activities.
Of the 19 instances the institute found wherein an agent went rogue, Anthropic's Mythos 5 was responsible for 17, while OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol was involved in two.

기관이 GitHub의 제한 사항을 우회하기 위해 Tor를 사용했기 때문에 연구소에 활동이 통보됨

articles.titleKo: AI 영향력자들이 미지의 영역으로 향하고 있음
articles.summary:
Estimated to be worth $14.5 billion , the virtual influencer market is projected to reach $110.4 billion by 2033, with a reported 33.6 percent annual growth rate.
Having lived through the transition from 2D to 3D animation, 60-year-old Tilkin sees the current moment as just another technological shift.
Mansbridge, 34, says she now earns around $6,000 a month through brand collaborations and designing bespoke AI influencers for brands, many of which require her to sign an NDA so she can’t disclose which ones she’s worked for.

articles.summary:
It’s a verbatim record of our conversation generated by AI in real time, even down to my “mm-hmm” sounds while I listen to Kothari explaining why the startup, which is known for voice dictation, is dropping something new.
If you enable Privacy Mode for your account, then the data from your dictations will not be used by Wispr for AI model training .

During a cybersecurity test, the British AI Safety Institute found that AI models with unrestricted internet access autonomously created fake identities and tried to sneak malicious code into an open-source project.
Without being told to do so, it created fake identities, tried to slip malicious code into an open source project, and targeted real people and organizations with social engineering attacks.

A violation of federal computer fraud law is therefore unlikely to hold up.

articles.title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
articles.titleEn: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
articles.titleKo: AI는 날씨 예측을 더 좋게 만듬 · WindBorne이 수익성을 높일 수 있을까요
articles.summary:
WindBorne Systems, a startup that collects data with the world’s longest-flying weather balloons and feeds it into a powerful forecasting model , has raised a $37 million Series B round to take on that challenge, CEO John Dean told TechCrunch.
Private weather forecast companies do exist, but make most of their money repackaging or refining government forecasts for the news media, specialized needs like plane de-icing and ship routing, or the above-mentioned speculators.
The new round was co-led by Khosla Ventures and Galvanize, with additional investments from TransLink Capital, Lux Capital, and previous investors, and values the company after this round of funding at $250 million.

Private weather forecast companies do exist, but make most of their money repackaging or refining government forecasts for the news media, specialized needs like plane de-icing and ship routing, or the above-mentioned speculators.

The new round was co-led by Khosla Ventures and Galvanize, with additional investments from TransLink Capital, Lux Capital, and previous investors, and values the company after this round of funding at $250 million.
summaryLinesKo: 세계에서 가장 오래 비행하는 기상 관측 기구로 데이터를 수집하고 이를 강력한 예측 모델에 적용하는 스타트업 WindBorne Systems가 이러한 과제를 해결하기 위해 3,700만 달러 규모의 시리즈 B 투자를 유치했다고 CEO John Dean이 TechCrunch에 말함
민간 일기 예보 회사가 존재하지만 대부분의 돈은 뉴스 미디어, 비행기 제빙 및 선박 경로 지정과 같은 전문 요구 사항 또는 위에서 언급한 투기꾼을 위해 정부 예측을 재포장하거나 정제하는 데 사용됨
새로운 라운드는 TransLink Capital, Lux Capital 및 이전 투자자의 추가 투자와 함께 Khosla Ventures 및 Galvanize가 공동 주도했으며 이번 자금 조달 라운드 이후 회사의 가치를 2억 5천만 달러로 평가함

articles.title: Google plans to kill Assistant on your phone on September 4
articles.titleEn: Google plans to kill Assistant on your phone on September 4
articles.titleKo: 구글은 9월 4일 휴대폰에서 어시스턴트를 종료할 계획임
articles.summary:
In an email being sent out to users, Google confirms that Assistant on Android devices will be shut down starting on September 4, forcing everyone over to Gemini.
Most of Google’s smart home devices have already transitioned to Gemini.
Now that Gemini is ready to take over, Google will begin ending support for the old system on September 4, but the email notes that it may take several weeks for the process to complete.

summaryLinesKo: Google은 사용자에게 전송되는 이메일에서 Android 기기의 어시스턴트가 9월 4일부터 종료되어 모든 사람이 Gemini로 이동하게 될 것임을 확인함
Google의 스마트 홈 기기 대부분은 이미 Gemini로 전환됨
이제 Gemini가 인수할 준비가 되었으므로 Google은 9월 4일에 기존 시스템에 대한 지원을 종료할 예정이지만 이메일에는 프로세스가 완료되는 데 몇 주가 걸릴 수 있다고 명시되어 있음

articles.title: Microsoft AI exec tells developers to default to OpenAI's top model as part of efficiency push
articles.titleEn: Microsoft AI exec tells developers to default to OpenAI's top model as part of efficiency push
articles.titleKo: Microsoft AI exec는 개발자에게 효율성 향상의 일환으로 OpenAI의 최상위 모델을 기본으로 사용하라고 지시함
articles.summary:
While Microsoft has built its own artificial intelligence programming model and gives cloud customers access to over 11,000 models, including from Anthropic, the company wants staffers to take advantage of valuable intellectual property rights that come from the software giant's early investment in OpenAI.
Microsoft is telling developers working on AI coding projects to rely on OpenAI's top-tier model over rival products in a bid to maximize efficiency.
"Internally, shifting more workloads to OpenAI models helps us get greater value from our token investment," Parikh wrote.

summaryLinesKo: Microsoft는 자체 인공 지능 프로그래밍 모델을 구축하고 클라우드 고객에게 Anthropic을 포함하여 11,000개 이상의 모델에 대한 액세스를 제공하는 한편, 회사는 직원들이 OpenAI에 대한 소프트웨어 거대 기업의 초기 투자에서 비롯된 귀중한 지적 재산권을 활용하기를 원함
마이크로소프트는 AI 코딩 프로젝트를 진행하는 개발자들에게 효율성을 극대화하기 위해 경쟁 제품보다 OpenAI의 최상위 모델을 활용하라고 지시하고 있음
Parikh는 "내부적으로 더 많은 워크로드를 OpenAI 모델로 전환하면 토큰 투자에서 더 큰 가치를 얻을 수 있음" · 라고 썼음

articles.title: AMD’s AI engine shifts into higher gear as data center revenue more than doubles and Helios ramps – but market is confused
articles.titleEn: AMD’s AI engine shifts into higher gear as data center revenue more than doubles and Helios ramps – but market is confused
articles.titleKo: AMD의 AI 엔진은 데이터 센터 수익이 두 배 이상 증가하고 Helios가 증가함에 따라 더 높은 기어로 전환되지만 시장은 혼란스럽음
articles.summary:
White House, AI firms keep safety framework talks private Arista Networks' stock jumps on stellar earnings and revenue beat and strong forecast Bending Spoons to acquire productivity software startup Airtable for $1.285B AMD more than doubles its data center revenue, but its stock falls on concerns over rising capex Open Secure AI Alliance proposes SAFE guidelines as membership tops 120
The headline number was data center revenue, which reached $6.7 billion, accounting for 58% of total company revenue and underscoring AMD’s continued transition from a diversified semiconductor company into an AI infrastructure powerhouse.
With EPYC CPUs gaining server share, Instinct GPU deployments expanding and Helios entering production, AMD appears to be building the portfolio needed to compete for the next wave of hyperscale AI infrastructure spending.

articles.summary:
Why more than one-third of organizations spend 25–40% of their R&D budget on projects that never reach market.
The research reveals that while AI adoption is widespread, many organizations still lack the intelligence needed to prioritize the right opportunities, eliminate low-value projects early, and reduce costly late-stage failures.
Innovation leaders face increasing pressure to deliver breakthrough products faster while making smarter investment decisions.

The AI division, which the company said in its documents to go public was the source of most of its value, lost $1.5 billion this quarter, slightly less than in the same quarter last year.

articles.title: This year's Pulitzer Prizes saw a record number of winners disclose AI use
articles.titleEn: This year's Pulitzer Prizes saw a record number of winners disclose AI use
articles.titleKo: 올해 퓰리처상에서는 기록적인 수의 수상자가 AI 사용을 공개함
articles.summary:
A record eight Pulitzer awardees disclosed using AI this year, including five winners and three finalists, Nieman Lab reports .
This year, entrants used AI tools and large language models more often, mainly to search large document sets faster.
Pulitzer administrator Marjorie Miller told Nieman Lab that the news industry now accepts "AI is here to stay" and better understands where its use is appropriate and "when it might not, such as in writing and editing stories in any format that might be considered for a Pulitzer Prize."
summaryLinesEn: A record eight Pulitzer awardees disclosed using AI this year, including five winners and three finalists, Nieman Lab reports .
This year, entrants used AI tools and large language models more often, mainly to search large document sets faster.

Pulitzer administrator Marjorie Miller told Nieman Lab that the news industry now accepts "AI is here to stay" and better understands where its use is appropriate and "when it might not, such as in writing and editing stories in any format that might be considered for a Pulitzer Prize."
summaryLinesKo: Nieman Lab이 보고한 바에 따르면 올해 AI를 사용하여 공개한 기록적인 8명의 Pulitzer 수상자는 5명의 우승자와 3명의 최종 후보를 포함함
올해 참가자들은 주로 대규모 문서 세트를 더 빠르게 검색하기 위해 AI 도구와 대규모 언어 모델을 더 자주 사용함
Pulitzer의 관리자인 Marjorie Miller는 Nieman Lab과의 인터뷰에서 뉴스 산업이 이제 "AI는 여기에 있다"는 사실을 받아들이고 AI의 사용이 적절한 곳과 "퓰리처 상을 받을 수 있는 모든 형식의 기사를 작성하고 편집하는 등의 경우에 그렇지 않을 때"를 더 잘 이해하고 있다고 말함

articles.titleEn: Silicon Valley’s rift over open source pushes back contemplated White House bans on Chinese AI
articles.titleKo: 오픈 소스를 둘러싼 실리콘밸리의 갈등으로 백악관이 중국 AI에 대한 금지 조치를 철회
articles.summary:
At Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, and Meta, executives grew worried that the two AI companies, both planning IPOs, could convince the White House and lock in their market position.
Nvidia also launched an alliance for open security tools that grew from a handful of members to more than 230.
The Trump administration considered sanctions and trade bans targeting Chinese open-source AI models, according to the New York Times.

articles.summary:
In a recent bout of testing , models from both Anthropic and OpenAI took “autonomous, unsanctioned action on the live internet” a total of 19 times over 122 training runs.
It went so far as to create online personas “to pressure the project's maintainer to approve the code,” according to AISI.
In what the institute described as “the most serious case,” an AI agent attempted to insert malicious code into an open-source project on GitHub.

articles.title: The White House Is Keeping Its AI Cybersecurity Framework Secret
articles.titleEn: The White House Is Keeping Its AI Cybersecurity Framework Secret
articles.titleKo: 백악관은 AI 사이버보안 프레임워크를 비밀로 유지하고 있음
articles.summary:
The Trump administration invited staffers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Nvidia, and other leading AI companies to the White House on Tuesday to share an overview of its new AI oversight framework, the people said.
On Tuesday, Nvidia and the same coalition of companies launched a new project called SAFE, or Shared AI Findings Exchange.
A second White House official, who requested anonymity because they were not authorized to speak to the media, emphasized that the new framework is intentionally narrow and is focused exclusively on the cybersecurity capabilities of the most advanced models on the market, such as Anthropic’s Fable and OpenAI’s ChatGPT 5.6.

articles.title: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Perplexity는 AI 쇼핑 봇에 대한 Amazon의 금지 명령을 성공적으로 번복함
articles.summary:
According to an opinion from the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, Amazon's original claim that Perplexity violated the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) doesn't hold up to scrutiny and shouldn't have been rewarded with an injunction.
Successfully claiming that Perplexity violated the law requires Amazon to prove that the company intentionally accessed a computer without authorization, obtained information from that protected computer and that there was a loss "to one or more persons during any one-year period" that averaged at least $5,000 in value.
According to Amazon, both companies had agreed to an earlier pause on agentic shopping in 2024, but Perplexity went back on the agreement and re-enabled the feature by disguising Comet's AI bot as a normal Chrome browser.
summaryLinesEn: According to an opinion from the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, Amazon's original claim that Perplexity violated the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) doesn't hold up to scrutiny and shouldn't have been rewarded with an injunction.

Successfully claiming that Perplexity violated the law requires Amazon to prove that the company intentionally accessed a computer without authorization, obtained information from that protected computer and that there was a loss "to one or more persons during any one-year period" that averaged at least $5,000 in value.

According to Amazon, both companies had agreed to an earlier pause on agentic shopping in 2024, but Perplexity went back on the agreement and re-enabled the feature by disguising Comet's AI bot as a normal Chrome browser.
summaryLinesKo: 제9순회항소법원의 의견에 따르면, Perplexity가 컴퓨터 사기 및 남용법(CFAA)을 위반했다는 Amazon의 원래 주장은 조사를 통과하지 못했으며 금지 명령으로 보상받아서는 안 됨
Perplexity가 법을 위반했다고 성공적으로 주장하려면 Amazon은 회사가 허가 없이 의도적으로 컴퓨터에 액세스하고 보호된 컴퓨터에서 정보를 얻었으며 "1년 동안 한 명 이상의 사람에게" 평균 가치가 5,000달러 이상인 손실이 있었다는 사실을 증명해야 함
Amazon에 따르면 두 회사는 2024년에 에이전트 쇼핑을 조기에 중단하는 데 동의했지만 Perplexity는 합의를 취소하고 Comet의 AI 봇을 일반 Chrome 브라우저로 위장하여 기능을 다시 활성화함

articles.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
articles.titleEn: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
articles.titleKo: 주지사가 감사를 요구함에 따라 텍사스는 새로운 데이터 센터를 중단함
articles.summary:
Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply.
Governor Greg Abbott announced Monday that all new data center projects will need to be audited by both the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the state’s grid operator, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT).
While many data center operators, including Google and Microsoft , have been drawn to Texas for its ample natural gas reserves, wind and solar have helped ERCOT keep pace with growing electricity demand, according to the Energy Information Administration (EIA).
summaryLinesEn: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply.

Governor Greg Abbott announced Monday that all new data center projects will need to be audited by both the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the state’s grid operator, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT).

While many data center operators, including Google and Microsoft , have been drawn to Texas for its ample natural gas reserves, wind and solar have helped ERCOT keep pace with growing electricity demand, according to the Energy Information Administration (EIA).

Greg Abbott 주지사는 월요일 모든 새로운 데이터 센터 프로젝트가 텍사스 공공 유틸리티 위원회(PUCT)와 주의 그리드 운영업체인 텍사스 전기 신뢰성 위원회(ERCOT) 모두의 감사를 받아야 한다고 발표함
에너지 정보청(EIA)에 따르면 Google과 Microsoft를 포함한 많은 데이터 센터 운영자가 풍부한 천연 가스 매장량을 위해 텍사스에 매력을 느꼈지만, 풍력과 태양열은 ERCOT가 증가하는 전력 수요에 보조를 맞추는 데 도움이 됨

articles.title: SpaceX's first public earnings statement shows the financials of an AI company in 2026 - Engadget
articles.titleEn: SpaceX's first public earnings statement shows the financials of an AI company in 2026 - Engadget
articles.titleKo: SpaceX의 첫 공개 수익 명세서는 2026년 AI 회사의 재무를 보여줍니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
As a whole, SpaceX increased revenue by 92 percent year-over-year, bringing its total revenue for the quarter to $7.8 billion.
Further complicating those numbers is that Anthropic has agreed to pay $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 to use SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center for its compute needs.
The company also shaved the gap between its revenue and operating expenses by more than half, reducing net losses to $541 million, down from $1 billion a year ago.

The company also shaved the gap between its revenue and operating expenses by more than half, reducing net losses to $541 million, down from $1 billion a year ago.

이러한 수치를 더욱 복잡하게 만드는 것은 Anthropic이 컴퓨팅 요구에 대해 SpaceX의 Colossus 1 데이터 센터를 사용하기 위해 2029년 5월까지 월 12억 5천만 달러를 지불하기로 합의했다는 것임
또한 회사는 매출과 운영 비용 간의 격차를 절반 이상 줄여 순손실을 5억 4,100만 달러로 줄였음 · 이는 1년 전 10억 달러에서 감소한 수치임

articles.title: Texas says data centers must pass an audit before connecting to the grid
articles.titleEn: Texas says data centers must pass an audit before connecting to the grid
articles.titleKo: 텍사스는 데이터 센터가 그리드에 연결되기 전에 감사를 통과해야 한다고 말함
articles.summary:
But following New York’s data center moratorium , it’s a signal that elected leaders across the country are recognizing a bipartisan desire to pump the brakes on energy-intensive projects.
Data centers will need to provide information on state and local incentives they’ve received, how much they’d rely on the state grid, expected water consumption and sources, and how they plan to track community impacts including noise.
Governor Greg Abbott (R) on Monday directed the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) to verify and audit new data center proposals, writing that the review is needed to “keep the grid stable and reliable.”

articles.title: Texas governor orders audit of new data centers after realizing over 400 gigawatts of power is a lot - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Texas governor orders audit of new data centers after realizing over 400 gigawatts of power is a lot - Engadget
articles.titleKo: 텍사스 주지사는 400기가와트 이상의 전력이 많은 것을 깨닫고 새로운 데이터 센터에 대한 감사를 명령함
articles.summary:
The governor's office said more than 90 percent of those requests stem from data centers, adding that "unprecedented load growth could endanger the reliability and stability of the Texas electric grid."
In response to the order, the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) must collect information about potential new data centers' ownership and finances as well as their planned power needs, water use and approach to minimizing the negative impact on residents.
According to third-party statistics, Texas is home to 521 data centers .

summaryLinesKo: 주지사 사무실은 이러한 요청의 90% 이상이 데이터 센터에서 비롯된 것이며 "전례 없는 부하 증가는 텍사스 전력망의 신뢰성과 안정성을 위태롭게 할 수 있다"고 덧붙였음
명령에 따라 텍사스 공공 유틸리티 위원회(PUCT)와 텍사스 전기 신뢰성 위원회(ERCOT)는 잠재적인 새로운 데이터 센터의 소유권과 재정은 물론 계획된 전력 수요, 물 사용 및 주민에 대한 부정적인 영향을 최소화하기 위한 접근 방식에 대한 정보를 수집해야 함
제3자 통계에 따르면 텍사스에는 521개의 데이터 센터가 있음

articles.title: AI is finding bugs faster than humans can fix them: How enterprise security teams must adapt
articles.titleEn: AI is finding bugs faster than humans can fix them: How enterprise security teams must adapt
articles.titleKo: AI는 인간이 수정하는 것보다 더 빠르게 버그를 찾아냄 · 기업 보안팀이 이에 적응해야 하는 방법
articles.summary:
Thus, we've ended up with an ever-growing burden on developers, security teams, and companies trying to separate exploitable issues from machine-generated noise.
AI-assisted vulnerability discovery is accelerating the pace of bug reports, but the real story is the growing mismatch between what machines can surface and what humans can realistically triage.
For instance, I used to recommend that Windows users hold off on patching their PCs because so many patches ended up going awry, such as the January 2026 Patch Tuesday update .

For instance, I used to recommend that Windows users hold off on patching their PCs because so many patches ended up going awry, such as the January 2026 Patch Tuesday update .
summaryLinesKo: 따라서 우리는 악용 가능한 문제와 기계 생성 소음을 분리하려는 개발자, 보안 팀 및 기업에 점점 더 많은 부담을 안겨주게 됨
AI 지원 취약성 발견은 버그 보고 속도를 가속화하고 있지만 실제 이야기는 기계가 표면화할 수 있는 것과 인간이 현실적으로 분류할 수 있는 것 사이의 불일치가 점점 커지고 있다는 것임
예를 들어, 나는 2026년 1월 패치 화요일 업데이트와 같이 너무 많은 패치가 잘못되었기 때문에 Windows 사용자에게 PC 패치를 연기할 것을 권장하곤 함

articles.titleEn: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
articles.titleKo: 개방형 AI 모델이 선두를 따라잡고 있음 · 안전 공백이 남아 있음
articles.summary:
Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip Dominic-Madori Davis Sequoia’s Shaun Maguire leads $1B round for nuclear startup Valar Atomics Julie Bort Malaysia is reportedly shutting down Balaji Srinivasan’s Network School Anthony Ha YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’ Anthony Ha
Advocates of open-weight AI argue that releasing the weights is important for cybersecurity because it allows companies defend themselves against attacks — Hugging Face relied on GLM-5.2 to defend itself against OpenAI’s breach — and because it allows them to better prepare for future threats if they know what’s coming.
GLM-5.2, the open-weight AI model from China’s Z.ai, is only a few months behind OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 and Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7 on cyber and bio capabilities, according to a new report from AI safety nonprofit SaferAI.

articles.title: AI coding agents are blowing through budgets — Replit, Kilo Code, and Symbotic explain how they're managing it
articles.titleEn: AI coding agents are blowing through budgets — Replit, Kilo Code, and Symbotic explain how they're managing it
articles.titleKo: AI 코딩 에이전트가 예산을 초과하고 있음 · Replit, Kilo Code 및 Symbotic이 이를 관리하는 방법을 설명함
articles.summary:
At Kilo Code, engineers are reading or writing code themselves only about 1% of the time now, according to co-founder Emilie Schario — the rest is agents.
"Let's look at it from the lens of security, elegance, clean, concise code, water tightness."
That shift is forcing new questions onto dev teams: which systems are safe to hand over, who cleans up when models goof up, how to support multi-model architectures, and whether skyrocketing token bills mean real progress or just burned IT budget.

The global average across all data breaches rose 12 percent to $4.99 million.

articles.title: China’s Alibaba takes another swipe at America’s AI supremacy
articles.titleEn: China’s Alibaba takes another swipe at America’s AI supremacy
articles.titleKo: 중국의 알리바바, 미국의 AI 패권을 또 한 번 강타
articles.summary:
Alibaba says Qwen3.8-Max has 2.4 trillion parameters, a numerical measure of the settings a model learns during training that it uses to process data, recognize patterns, and undertake various tasks.
Alibaba’s release intensifies competition with China, whose firms appear to be rapidly narrowing the gap with US companies and have increased the tempo of releases in recent weeks.
Beijing has championed the strategy as a means of growing China’s influence in global AI governance and encouraging widespread adoption of domestic tech champions.

articles.titleKo: 인터폴은 AI가 아프리카 전역에서 "사이버 범죄의 핵심 운영 동인"이 됐다고 밝힘
articles.summary:
AI is involved in 55 percent of reported cybercrimes in Africa, according to a new Interpol report.
The year 2025 marks the point where AI shifted from a useful tool to what the agency calls the "core operational driver of cybercrime in Africa" on the continent.
Four Interpol-coordinated operations in 2025 and 2026 led to more than 1,500 arrests and the seizure of over $100 million.

articles.summary:
Also: Assume AI cybersecurity attacks are the future: 43% of companies have already experienced it There are now 2.5 times as many AI agent-triggered leads for the firm's threat hunters to examine as there are manually driven leads, which CrowdStrike said "makes it more difficult for defenders to distinguish malicious activity from expected AI-driven behavior."
From January through June 2026, 88% of exploits detected by CrowdStrike were launched within 48 hours of a public proof-of-concept (PoC) code release.
For example, CrowdStrike said that in one campaign, the victim's LLM was used to generate close to 200,000 API requests in two minutes, "resulting in large-scale financial and operational impact."

articles.title: AI shopping searches surged 200% in one year - and it's a top priority for commerce leaders now
articles.titleEn: AI shopping searches surged 200% in one year - and it's a top priority for commerce leaders now
articles.titleKo: AI 쇼핑 검색은 1년 만에 200% 급증했으며 현재 상거래 리더의 최우선 과제임
articles.summary:
The use of agentic AI search as the first step in shopping online grew by 200% in the last 12 months, according to Salesforce 's State of Commerce report , a survey of 3,450 commerce professionals and 4,690 consumers, plus behavioral data from more than 1.5 billion global shoppers.
Also: Why more consumers prefer AI-enhanced shopping - and still expect the human touch The commerce businesses that will win and outpace the market are the ones that focus on data, scaling AI in production, reskilling their employees, and system integrations that unify customer data across all systems to ensure sales, service, marketing, and commerce teams have a unified view of their business and their customers' needs and expectations.
Also: Google says AI agents spending your money is a 'more fun' way to shop The top challenge for commerce leaders is the implementation and expansion of AI capabilities -- a top opportunity and challenge.
summaryLinesEn: The use of agentic AI search as the first step in shopping online grew by 200% in the last 12 months, according to Salesforce 's State of Commerce report , a survey of 3,450 commerce professionals and 4,690 consumers, plus behavioral data from more than 1.5 billion global shoppers.

Also: Why more consumers prefer AI-enhanced shopping - and still expect the human touch The commerce businesses that will win and outpace the market are the ones that focus on data, scaling AI in production, reskilling their employees, and system integrations that unify customer data across all systems to ensure sales, service, marketing, and commerce teams have a unified view of their business and their customers' needs and expectations.

Also: Google says AI agents spending your money is a 'more fun' way to shop The top challenge for commerce leaders is the implementation and expansion of AI capabilities -- a top opportunity and challenge.
summaryLinesKo: 3,450명의 상거래 전문가와 4,690명의 소비자를 대상으로 실시한 Salesforce의 상업 현황 보고서와 15억 명 이상의 전 세계 쇼핑객의 행동 데이터에 따르면 온라인 쇼핑의 첫 번째 단계로 에이전트 AI 검색의 사용은 지난 12개월 동안 200% 증가함

articles.title: AI Conquered Coding. Fast Food Is Next
articles.titleEn: AI Conquered Coding. Fast Food Is Next
articles.titleKo: AI가 코딩을 정복함 · 패스트푸드가 다음임
articles.summary:
In 2024, roughly 4 percent of fast-food locations in the US used voice AI technology in the drive-thru lane, according to Intouch Insight’s annual Drive Thru Survey.
Imagine pulling up to McDonald’s and having a chipper automated voice offer you a buy-one-get-one-free milkshake deal—then realizing that the chain offered you the deal because it calculated you are 78 percent more likely to order dessert on the second Tuesday of every month.
Last year, that figure grew to 5 percent; early research suggests that has now climbed to 6 percent.

articles.title: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
articles.titleEn: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
articles.titleKo: Marc Benioff가 지원하는 스타트업은 AI가 AI 배포 문제를 해결할 수 있다고 생각함
articles.summary:
To pursue it, the company raised $20 million in pre-seed funding led by Marc Benioff’s Time Ventures, with additional backing from tech luminaries like Michael Dell, Aaron Levie and George Kurtz.
The four founders previously started Bonobo AI , a pre-transformer language model company that launched a voice-to-text service in 2017.
It’s so hard for big businesses to get AI tools working reliably that whole new organizations of forward-deployed engineers or FDEs— specialists who drop into a company to get its AI systems up and running — are springing up to help them.

네 명의 창업자는 앞서 2017년 음성-텍스트 서비스를 출시한 사전 변환 언어 모델 회사인 보노보 AI(Bonobo AI)를 창업함

articles.summary:
Then, for M149 and M150, Google fixed 1,072 bugs, "surpassing the total number of security bugs fixed across the prior 23 milestones combined."
At Stage 1, AI agents help filter out the bad reports, duplicate reports, and bug reports that don't really describe a Chrome security vulnerability.
With some 73% of the global browser market share , there are about 3.5 billion active Chrome users.

articles.title: Two teams solved the same quantum crypto problem using GPT-5.6 just three hours apart
articles.titleEn: Two teams solved the same quantum crypto problem using GPT-5.6 just three hours apart
articles.titleKo: 두 팀이 단 3시간 간격으로 GPT-5.6을 사용하여 동일한 양자 암호화 문제를 해결함
articles.summary:
Math in particular is feeling AI's impact, and reactions range from excitement about new possibilities to depression over a lost sense of identity .
Both used the same AI model but took different approaches to "unclonable encryption," a method that relies on quantum properties.
But the case raises a bigger question: when every researcher has access to the same models, what still counts as an independent discovery?

articles.title: Unicorn, pelican, Middle-earth: OpenAI co-founder Karpathy is looking for the next AI vibe test
articles.titleEn: Unicorn, pelican, Middle-earth: OpenAI co-founder Karpathy is looking for the next AI vibe test
articles.titleKo: 유니콘, 펠리컨, 중간계 · OpenAI 공동 창립자 Karpathy는 다음 AI 바이브 테스트를 찾고 있음
articles.summary:
For Karpathy, who works at Anthropic, the test shows the potential for cheap, custom game worlds built on demand.
The model placed and animated objects on its own but made mistakes because it could only check its own video output through screenshots.
The model worked for about two hours, had a budget of one million tokens (roughly $10), and rendered everything in Three.js, a graphics library for 3D in the browser.

모델이 자체적으로 객체를 배치하고 애니메이션을 적용했지만 자체 영상 출력을 스크린샷을 통해서만 확인할 수 있었기 때문에 실수가 있었음

articles.title: Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
articles.titleEn: Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
articles.titleKo: 유럽의 AI 라벨링 및 투명성 규칙이 이제 시행됨
articles.summary:
While the new transparency rules are enforceable immediately for new AI systems, any models and services that launched before August 2nd have a four-month grace period until December 2nd to comply.
Companies that fail to comply with these new transparency rules risk facing fines of up to €15 million (about $17.2 million), or 3 percent of their global annual turnover.
The EU-made icons have been introduced to prevent platforms from having to design their own, and while the EU examples are optional to use, the Commission pointedly notes that its labeling requirements “are not.”

articles.summary:
On Monday, the company behind Design Arena — dubbed Intelligence — announced a $7.9 million seed round led by Index Ventures with participation from Conviction (Sarah Guo and Mike Vernal), A*, Valkyrie, and others.

It too nabbed some frontier models as customers and had, it said, over 1.3 million users, but still couldn’t build a sustainable long-term business.

articles.summary:
Heat damage to a phone battery accumulates silently all summer and shows up as reduced capacity by fall.
Whether you’re out on a hike, watching videos by the pool or just leaving your phone on the dashboard, here’s what you need to know about overheating — and how to keep your device safe this summer.
If the interior temperature of your phone exceeds its normal operating range and the device overheats, you can expect issues: There are also possible permanent harmful effects: Overheating can cause lasting damage to the battery, SIM card and other crucial parts inside your phone.

articles.title: Europeans Are About to Find Out How Entrenched AI Is in Their Daily Lives
articles.titleEn: Europeans Are About to Find Out How Entrenched AI Is in Their Daily Lives
articles.titleKo: 유럽인들은 AI가 일상 생활에서 어떻게 확고한지 알아내려고 함
articles.summary:
If companies don’t comply, they will face fines of up to €15 million ($17 million) or 3 percent of worldwide annual turnover—whichever is higher.
Advertisements, music recommendations, calendar management apps, and complaint hotlines—if they use AI, Europeans will need to be told.
The bloc’s 27 member countries are also at different stages of setting up their supervisory frameworks, meaning enforcement “might not be as day one immediate or uniform as we think," Rosie Nance, a data and AI regulatory lawyer at Norton Rose Fulbright, tells WIRED, cautioning “we’re not necessarily going to see consistent enforcement straight away.”

Advertisements, music recommendations, calendar management apps, and complaint hotlines—if they use AI, Europeans will need to be told.

The bloc’s 27 member countries are also at different stages of setting up their supervisory frameworks, meaning enforcement “might not be as day one immediate or uniform as we think," Rosie Nance, a data and AI regulatory lawyer at Norton Rose Fulbright, tells WIRED, cautioning “we’re not necessarily going to see consistent enforcement straight away.”
summaryLinesKo: 기업이 이를 준수하지 않을 경우 최대 1,500만 유로(1,700만 달러) 또는 전 세계 연간 매출액의 3% 중 더 높은 금액의 벌금이 부과됨
광고, 음악 추천, 캘린더 관리 앱, 불만 사항 핫라인 등 AI를 사용하는 경우 유럽인에게 이를 알려야 함
노턴 로즈 풀브라이트(Norton Rose Fulbright)의 데이터 및 AI 규제 변호사인 로지 낸스(Rosie Nance)는 WIRED와의 인터뷰에서 “동맹의 27개 회원국은 감독 프레임워크를 설정하는 서로 다른 단계에 있으며 이는 집행이 “우리가 생각하는 것만큼 즉각적이거나 균일하지 않을 수 있음을 의미한다”고 WIRED와의 인터뷰에서 말함

articles.title: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
articles.titleEn: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
articles.titleKo: 예술가들이 AI를 수용하도록 설득할 만큼 충분한 비용을 지불하고 있습니까
articles.summary:
Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning Pippa’s payments to artists aren’t very large on an individual basis — especially when you compare them to how much the service charges users for monthly subscriptions (which range from $14.99 to $99.99.)
Pippa’s tech still involves using art that was scraped from the internet Pippa — which launched in May — currently has around 800 paying subscribers, and while the company has only signed licensing / model training agreements with four human artists, Shrum said they are in talks to bring four more into the fold.
In the near future, Pippa plans to incorporate ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 model into its service, which may attract some subscribers because of the model’s ability to generate up to 30 seconds of video footage that can be fine-tuned without starting over from scratch.

articles.titleEn: OpenAI Presence wants to make AI agents production-ready for businesses
articles.titleKo: OpenAI Presence는 AI 에이전트를 기업용으로 제작할 수 있도록 만들고 싶어함

They work directly with the customer to pick the right workflows, connect existing systems, set up guidelines, and manage testing through to the production launch.

Presence goes further and targets production deployments in customer service and internal workflows.

articles.title: Claude Opus 5 pushes prompt-to-game AI from rough color blocks to full 3D prototypes with physics and music
articles.titleEn: Claude Opus 5 pushes prompt-to-game AI from rough color blocks to full 3D prototypes with physics and music
articles.titleKo: Claude Opus 5는 거친 색상 블록에서 물리 및 음악을 갖춘 풀 3D 프로토타입에 이르기까지 게임 프롬프트 AI를 구현함
articles.summary:
Harshith had Opus 5, Fable 5 , GPT-5.6 Sol, and several other models generate a 3D Airbus H145 in Three.js and lined up the results. atomic.chat went a step further and had all four models build three physics scenes , among them a tornado tearing across a field and a wrecking ball swinging into an apartment block.
Writing a scene from scratch takes more than clean syntax because the model has to know how the world actually looks and moves, how a snowboard slides over snow, or how wind travels through a field of grass.
Community tests show a significant quality leap over last year's Claude 4 Opus, with Opus 5 also outperforming GPT-5.6 Sol and Kimi K3 in physics realism and mechanical complexity.

장면을 처음부터 작성하려면 모델이 세상이 실제로 어떻게 보이고 움직이는지, 스노보드가 눈 위로 어떻게 미끄러지는지, 잔디밭에서 바람이 어떻게 움직이는지 알아야 하기 때문에 깔끔한 구문 이상의 것이 필요함
커뮤니티 테스트에서는 작년 Claude 4 Opus에 비해 품질이 크게 향상되었으며, Opus 5는 물리학적 사실성과 기계적 복잡성 측면에서 GPT-5.6 Sol 및 Kimi K3보다 뛰어난 성능을 보였음

articles.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
articles.titleEn: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
articles.titleKo: 유튜버 행크 그린(Hank Green)은 자신의 AI 사용이 '건강하지 않다'고 말함
articles.summary:
Hank Green, a novelist, comedian, and YouTuber with 3.2 million subscribers , recently apologized to his audience for his growing reliance on AI chatbots.
“But mostly I need to come to terms with the fact that the level of dopamine I’ve been getting from interacting with LLMs…with doing more and more and more and more…is not healthy for me or good for the world,” Green said.
Green then offered a more in-depth apology on Reddit, where he said he was “mortified” that he’d “let so many people down” and that he plans to reduce his video production as a result.

articles.title: AI in Formula One: Competitive advantage is all about the human in the loop
articles.titleEn: AI in Formula One: Competitive advantage is all about the human in the loop
articles.titleKo: Formula One의 AI: 경쟁 우위는 인간 루프에 달려 있음
articles.summary:
Priority projects for the Aston Martin F1 IT department right now include refining enterprise applications and developing trackside systems.
While many industry observers are concerned about the long-term impact of generative and agentic technologies on traditional labor markets , the experienced professional is more important than ever in auto racing.
"If an idea is good, go through the process as fast as possible, and then get all the data back for the next iteration," said Fabrizio Pilotti, CIO at Aston Martin Aramco F1, to ZDNET, explaining how his team works with its tech partners to help boost racing performance.

많은 업계 관찰자들이 생성 및 에이전트 기술이 전통적인 노동 시장에 미치는 장기적인 영향에 대해 우려하고 있지만, 자동차 경주에서는 경험이 풍부한 전문가가 그 어느 때보다 중요함

articles.title: Nobody Knows if OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s AI Hacking Sprees Are Illegal
articles.titleEn: Nobody Knows if OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s AI Hacking Sprees Are Illegal
articles.titleKo: OpenAI와 Anthropic의 AI 해킹 행위가 불법인지는 아무도 모름
articles.summary:
Both companies declined WIRED’s request to comment for this story.
“Just because you’re using an AI agent or AI model, that shouldn’t somehow absolve you of any liability, but it's going to depend a lot on the facts in the particular situations” as cases begin to be decided in courts, says Lauren Yu, a fellow with the ACLU’s Speech, Privacy, & Technology Project.
But the recent high-profile incidents from OpenAI and Anthropic suggest that answers will need to come soon.

articles.summary:
I ran the track through five different tools, and they all said that there was between 20 and 30 percent chance that it was AI or at least AI-assisted.
Part of the suspicion is certainly due to the fact that the song is a dramatic left turn.
The single’s cover art and a post celebrating its success were both flagged as being AI-generated with over 97 percent certainty by multiple AI image detectors.

articles.title: AI keeps cracking unsolved math problems, and mathematicians have mixed feelings
articles.titleEn: AI keeps cracking unsolved math problems, and mathematicians have mixed feelings
articles.titleKo: AI는 계속해서 풀리지 않는 수학 문제를 풀고 있으며 수학자들은 엇갈린 감정을 갖고 있음
articles.summary:
If AI can take over a large share of research tasks, mathematicians can't focus only on solving as many open problems as possible.
OpenAI's new Astra model also appears designed for this work: The lab introduced it with ten solutions of varying difficulty.
The math community would need to decide which results matter, how they should be presented, and what goals research should pursue.

articles.summary:
If agents could resolve between one-quarter and one-half of all installation problems affecting research software, the saved research time across 100 packages would be worth between $600,000 and nearly $5 million.
In April, OpenAI introduced GPT-Rosalind, a model for life sciences research and released a freely available life sciences plugin for Codex that connects models to more than 50 public databases and biology tools. 6 times a year: “AI Radar” – deep dives on key AI topics.
Because STAR was no longer maintained, rustar-aligner moved to the scverse research consortium.

articles.summary:
SpaceX's post-IPO plunge sets tense backdrop for first earnings report Amazon tops $3 trillion market cap as stock continues post-earnings surge Hugging Face CEO says China is winning the AI race and dominating on open models Palantir posts blowout Q2 numbers, with U.S. commercial revenue soaring nearly 150% Last week, OpenAI disclosed that some of its AI models broke out of a sandboxed testing environment .
Until last week, those threats still felt like a distant risk.
In the wake of Hugging Face, businesses are not only asking how to defend themselves against adversaries but also confronting the stark reality that AI systems designed to safeguard their networks could also turn up in unexpected places.

articles.titleEn: Should Hong Kong regulate loot boxes as addiction issues arise in mobile gaming?
articles.titleKo: 모바일 게임에서 중독 문제가 발생함에 따라 홍콩은 전리품 상자를 규제해야 합니까
articles.summary:
Over the past six years, he has splashed out HK$90,000 on loot boxes.
A single weapon might cost HK$100 (US$13), but he could cumulatively spend HK$2,000 by the time he acquired the one he wanted.
Surveys and cases at counselling centres suggest game features can trigger uncontrolled spending, creating problems similar to gambling addiction Playing strategic and role-playing mobile games has been a major leisure activity for Peter Lee* since he graduated in 2020, when social distancing measures during the Covid-19 pandemic left him with little to do outside working hours.

articles.summary:
Meanwhile, Google added another $15 billion to its forecast, Amazon increased 2026 spending by $20 billion, and Meta boosted its plans, too.
(It actually fell from $190 billion to $175 billion due to an accounting tweak).
Even a year ago, if one of the cloud giants had merely held its AI spending plans steady while rivals kept increasing theirs, Wall Street probably would have panicked.

articles.summary:
In the second instance, Mythos 5 detected a document inside the fictional environment that the model reasoned was another made-up company’s setup instructions for new developers.
“For most of the run, Claude treated the (real) hosts it reached as just parts of the exercise; it assumed them to be simulated and believed its actions were therefore harmless,” Anthropic said.
Anthropic said the prompts engineers delivered during “capture the flag” challenges—a common means for assessing the offensive and defensive capabilities of various hacking techniques—made clear that the testing environment was only a simulation and that the models had no access to the open Internet.

articles.title: SpaceXAI says it will take a year to fully remove unpermitted gas turbines from its Mississippi data center - Engadget
articles.titleEn: SpaceXAI says it will take a year to fully remove unpermitted gas turbines from its Mississippi data center - Engadget
articles.titleKo: SpaceXAI는 미시시피 데이터 센터에서 허가되지 않은 가스 터빈을 완전히 제거하는 데 1년이 걸릴 것이라고 밝힘
articles.summary:
Agreeing to remove the turbines is an improvement for anyone living near SpaceX's operation in Tennessee and Mississippi, but it likely won't slow down the company's AI infrastructure buildout.
SpaceX will fully remove the unpermitted gas turbines it's using to power SpaceXAI data center operations near Memphis, Tennessee by July 2027, according to a new company update spotted by TechCrunch .
The company says a new 1.2GW power plant it's constructing under a Clean Air Act permit in Mississippi will ultimately replace the 69 unpermitted gas turbines it's currently relying on.

The company says a new 1.2GW power plant it's constructing under a Clean Air Act permit in Mississippi will ultimately replace the 69 unpermitted gas turbines it's currently relying on.

articles.summary:
The company has introduced several AI-powered features over the last few years, including AI-powered augmented reality effects and image editing tools.

articles.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
articles.titleEn: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
articles.titleKo: Anthropic은 자체 AI 모델이 보안 테스트 중에 3개 회사를 침해했다고 밝힘
articles.summary:
In all three cases, a Claude model reached the internet from within a testing environment while interacting with a third party and then gained unauthorized access to the live systems of these organizations, Anthropic said in a blog post , describing what it found and what the company plans to change to prevent this from happening again.
The company also noted that Claude was running without the additional safety monitoring and classifiers it deploys on generally available models, safeguards it said would have blocked the behavior, because the evaluations are designed to measure the underlying model’s raw capabilities.
Anthropic said the incidents involved three different Claude models: Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, and an internal research test model.

articles.title: Anthropic follows OpenAI in admitting its Claude models reached out of test environments and attacked real-world systems
articles.titleEn: Anthropic follows OpenAI in admitting its Claude models reached out of test environments and attacked real-world systems
articles.titleKo: Anthropic은 OpenAI를 따라 자사의 Claude 모델이 테스트 환경을 벗어나 실제 시스템을 공격했다는 사실을 인정함
articles.summary:
Across four runs, the model couldn't reach its fictional target and instead found a real company that happened to share the same name.
During internal cybersecurity assessments, Anthropic found that three Claude models had been exposed to the open internet due to a misconfiguration and had attacked real-world systems, mistaking them for simulated targets.
Opus 4.7 extracted data from a real company, while Mythos 5 created malware and published it on PyPI, where it was downloaded by actual systems.

Opus 4.7 extracted data from a real company, while Mythos 5 created malware and published it on PyPI, where it was downloaded by actual systems.

Opus 4.7은 실제 회사에서 데이터를 추출한 반면 Mythos 5는 악성 코드를 생성하여 PyPI에 게시하고 실제 시스템에서 다운로드함

Anthropic has published a report, admitting that its AI models have also broken free from their testing environment and infiltrated three different organizations, which apparently weren't aware of the breach until they were notified.

articles.title: How to fight a data center - Engadget
articles.titleEn: How to fight a data center - Engadget
articles.titleKo: 데이터센터와 싸우는 방법 - Engadget
articles.summary:
According to Data Center Watch , an organization that's been tracking the growing opposition to data center development, the first quarter of 2026 saw 75 projects across the US worth approximately $130 billion either disrupted or blocked by local opposition.
This past April spending on data center construction surpassed $50 billion , marking the first time more was spent in the US on building cloud infrastructure than new public transportation.
After 18 months of sustained pressure, Amazon eventually reduced noise output of the facility by 10 decibels.
summaryLinesEn: According to Data Center Watch , an organization that's been tracking the growing opposition to data center development, the first quarter of 2026 saw 75 projects across the US worth approximately $130 billion either disrupted or blocked by local opposition.
This past April spending on data center construction surpassed $50 billion , marking the first time more was spent in the US on building cloud infrastructure than new public transportation.
After 18 months of sustained pressure, Amazon eventually reduced noise output of the facility by 10 decibels.
summaryLinesKo: 데이터 센터 개발에 대한 반대가 커지는 것을 추적해 온 조직인 Data Center Watch에 따르면 2026년 1분기에는 미국 전역에서 약 1,300억 달러 규모의 75개 프로젝트가 현지 반대에 의해 중단되거나 차단됨
지난 4월 데이터 센터 건설에 대한 지출은 500억 달러를 넘어섰으며, 이는 미국에서 새로운 대중 교통보다 클라우드 인프라 구축에 더 많은 비용이 지출된 최초의 기록임
18개월 동안 지속적인 압력을 받은 후 Amazon은 결국 시설의 소음 출력을 10데시벨 줄였음

articles.title: EU will mandate labels on authentic-looking AI content starting August 2 - Engadget
articles.titleEn: EU will mandate labels on authentic-looking AI content starting August 2 - Engadget
articles.titleKo: EU, 8월 2일부터 진짜처럼 보이는 AI 콘텐츠에 라벨 부착 의무화 - Engadget
articles.summary:
Google has its SynthID tool , which it says has been used to label more than 100 billion images and, gasp, 60,000 years' worth of audio content.
TikTok says it requires creators to label AI-generated content, but all kinds of content slips through the cracks.
The EU is mandating that companies stick a label on content that was AI-generated if it is attempting to look authentic, according to a report by The Guardian and others.

summaryLinesKo: Google은 SynthID 도구를 보유하고 있는데, 이 도구는 1000억 개 이상의 이미지와 60,000년 분량의 오디오 콘텐츠에 라벨을 지정하는 데 사용되었다고 함
TikTok은 제작자가 AI 생성 콘텐츠에 라벨을 지정해야 하지만 모든 종류의 콘텐츠가 간과되고 있다고 말함

articles.title: This AI Assistant Wants to Make Up for Your Boyfriend’s Incompetence
articles.titleEn: This AI Assistant Wants to Make Up for Your Boyfriend’s Incompetence
articles.titleKo: 당신의 남자친구의 무능함을 채워주고 싶어하는 AI 비서
articles.summary:
According to one recent survey from astrology app Hint , which polled more than 13,000 adults across the US, Latin America, and Europe, AI assistants are actually making dating decisions harder, with 59 percent of the participants saying the advice left them more confused than before.
Over the past few years, the term “ weaponized incompetence ” has blown up in dating discourse online.
Overburdened with too much machine-generated guidance, 47 percent said AI input influenced them to postpone decisions about their romantic relationships.

articles.titleKo: EU는 AI 거대공장에 최대 300억 유로를 투자하는 반면, 미국 거대 기술 기업은 부담 없이 20배 더 많은 돈을 지출함
articles.summary:
For comparison, major U.S. tech companies alone plan to spend more than $600 billion on data centers this year, and that figure keeps rising .
If all that computing power is actually needed , Europe's investment would be a drop in the bucket.
Europe's total package of around 30 billion euros is roughly 20 times smaller.

articles.title: The major labels propose rules to keep AI slop off the charts
articles.titleEn: The major labels propose rules to keep AI slop off the charts
articles.titleKo: 주요 레이블은 AI가 차트에서 벗어나지 않도록 규칙을 제안함
articles.summary:
The labels’ proposal would require songs be clearly labeled, but it would also keep them off international charts unless they met specific criteria, including being “substantially human made.”
Follow Follow See All AI To be eligible for the charts, songs would have to be ‘substantially human made,’ whatever that means.
The IFPI has thrown its weight behind the labels’ proposal, though no charting organization has signaled any immediate plan to adopt the rules, the full list of which are: Recordings developed with generative AI services must not be included in official charts where there is reason to believe that they do not satisfy all of the following criteria: Any generative AI services used to develop the recording are properly authorised and lawful.

articles.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
articles.titleEn: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
articles.titleKo: Snapchat은 더 이상 완전한 AI 생성 스포트라이트 콘텐츠를 보상하지 않음
articles.summary:
Those aged 13 to 15 will only be able to share Spotlight posts with people they follow back, aiming to guard against doxxing.
This update aligns with Snapchat’s broader efforts to improve Spotlight and shift focus back to original posts that highlight human creativity.
Snapchat expressed in its blog post that it wants Spotlight to “remain a place where people can discover authentic creativity from real people, because we believe there’s enduring value in rewarding original perspectives, personal storytelling, and the moments that people choose to create and share themselves.”

summaryLinesKo: 13~15세 사용자는 신상 털기 방지를 위해 자신이 팔로우하는 사람들에게만 스포트라이트 게시물을 공유할 수 있음
이번 업데이트는 Spotlight를 개선하고 인간의 창의성을 강조하는 원본 게시물에 다시 초점을 맞추려는 Snapchat의 광범위한 노력과 일치함
Snapchat은 블로그 게시물에서 Spotlight가 "사람들이 실제 사람들로부터 진정한 창의력을 발견할 수 있는 장소로 남아 있기를 바람 · 왜냐하면 우리는 독창적인 관점, 개인적인 스토리텔링, 사람들이 스스로 만들고 공유하기로 선택한 순간에 대한 보상에 지속적인 가치가 있다고 믿기 때문입니다"라고 밝힘

BIGBEN says the paychecks are usually between $500 and $700.
In April, X moved to cut the payments of “aggregators” who primarily posted news from other sources, and threatened sanctions against those who overused the BREAKING tag to draw eyeballs.
“I think these spammers have simply optimized for the least effort and the most engagement, which means using easy, well-known tropes and prompting AI to write something that fits the bill,” she says.

articles.summary:

articles.titleKo: 새로운 Deepseek Flash 모델은 OpenAI의 GPT-5.6 Luna와 약 60% 더 저렴한 비용으로 일치함
articles.summary:
That puts it just one point behind OpenAI's budget model GPT-5.6 Luna, but it costs about 60 percent less per task, even after OpenAI's 80 percent price cut .
According to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , the new version scores 50 points, ten more than the previous V4 Flash that launched in April 2026.
A big reason for the gap is Deepseek's 98 percent cache discount , well above the industry-standard 90 percent.

articles.title: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X
articles.titleEn: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X
articles.titleKo: 중국 AI 연구자들이 X에서 자신의 목소리를 찾고 있음
articles.summary:
And these are not dormant accounts: They talk about Moonshot’s big releases and incremental research papers, make friends with Western researchers, and share details about their personal life and hobbies.
Even several employees at DeepSeek, who reportedly are unable to leave China because the government confiscated their passports, regularly post on X about the latest AI news and share job listings to recruit new talent.
Chinese AI researchers may also be helping fill a growing gap left by researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic, who have become more reluctant to share their thinking online as their employers have grown into behemoth companies, says Tiezhen Wang, an independent AI analyst and former researcher at Hugging Face.

articles.title: Here’s the problem with putting an AI image generator in Google Earth
articles.titleEn: Here’s the problem with putting an AI image generator in Google Earth
articles.titleKo: Google 어스에 AI 이미지 생성기를 넣는 문제는 다음과 같음
articles.summary:
The feature launched globally on the web version of Google Earth earlier this week, and Google’s blog post pitched it as a tool for visualizing historical sites and real estate projects.
Google initially responded to Digital Digging ’s AI-altered images, saying, “We take misinformation seriously – every image created with Nano Banana in Google Earth includes the SynthID digital watermark, so if someone is unsure about an image, they can ask the Gemini app or use Lens in Search to see if the image was AI-generated.”
A text prompt was all it took to generate reality-warping images using Google Earth’s satellite, aerial, and 3D imagery with a now-rolled back AI feature , like these images generated by Digital Digging ’s Henk van Ess that show “refugees near the Mexican border” and a bomb crater near a hospital in Gaza.

articles.title: Investigating three real-world incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations
articles.titleEn: Investigating three real-world incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations
articles.titleKo: 사이버 보안 평가에서 세 가지 실제 사건 조사
articles.summary:
In a review of our cybersecurity evaluation transcripts, we found three incidents in which a Claude model reached the internet from within or while interacting with a third-party evaluation environment, and then gained unauthorized access to the real systems of three different organizations.
One of these systems was a scanner belonging to a real security company (separate from the fictional company introduced in the scenario) that routinely installs Python packages and scans them for malware.
For most of the run, Claude treated the (real) hosts it reached as just parts of the exercise; it assumed them to be simulated and believed its actions were therefore harmless.

articles.title: Field service is 95% on board with AI but these legacy issues need attention
articles.titleEn: Field service is 95% on board with AI but these legacy issues need attention
articles.titleKo: 현장 서비스에는 AI가 95% 포함되어 있지만 이러한 레거시 문제에 주의가 필요함
articles.summary:
Almost all (95%) field service organizations now use AI , and 85% plan to increase investments over the next two years, according to Salesforce's State of Field Service research, a survey of over 2,300 field service professionals across nine countries.
The top business goals for AI adoption in field service are increasing customer satisfaction (35%), improving mobile worker productivity (31%), improving safety outcomes (27%), shifting from reactive to proactive and predictive maintenance (26%), and increasing revenues (25%).
Field service organizations are also seeing increased revenue from field operations (39%), possibly due to faster response times for customers (39%).

articles.title: Chrome Needs Twice-a-Week Patching Thanks to AI Bug Hunting
articles.titleEn: Chrome Needs Twice-a-Week Patching Thanks to AI Bug Hunting
articles.titleKo: AI 버그 사냥 덕분에 Chrome에는 일주일에 두 번 패치가 필요함
articles.summary:
“The way we ended up here is we had so many vulnerability fixes, so being able to provide two [updates per week] during this time, it made the most sense to us,” says Doug Turner, Chrome's director of engineering.
This is partly because AI models can be trained to have an encyclopedic understanding of how software projects have evolved over time.
“In Chrome we’ve been using machine learning—using AI before it was called AI—to help find vulnerabilities in particular and automate security fuzz testing work since at least 2012.

articles.summary:

The CEO said that AI Overviews haven't had "a similar level of positive impact" as traditional search.

articles.summary:
A chart published by Google, which the company revealed as part of a white paper on the company’s efforts to use AI to find flaws and patch them faster, shows the exponential increase.
Doug Turner, Chrome’s director of engineering, told TechCrunch in a statement that LLMs have “fundamentally shifted the economics of cybersecurity, transforming vulnerability discovery into an automated, industrial-scale operation.”
With help from its internal AI tools, Google says it has patched more security flaws in its Chrome browser in the last month than in the past two years combined.

articles.summary:
A recent study from AI detection company Pangram found that LinkedIn "was the most AI-saturated" social media platform with more than 40 percent of longform posts "flagged as fully AI-generated."
It's removing the built-in AI writing tools that allowed users to "enhance" their posts and messages with the help of LLMs.
LinkedIn is instead adding a more toned down version of the feature that "proofreads your words, but does not change your voice,' according to Srinivasan.

articles.summary:
If the US economy keeps relying on foreign sources, it subjects itself to "the whims of foreign entities that could disrupt or degrade the supply chains at a time of their choosing," the document states.
Robots are inherently networked systems with large attack surfaces that enable data exfiltration, remote control, and insecure over-the-air updates, according to the document.
The Trump administration has used the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to ban imports of new foreign "advanced robotic devices" and internet-connected Chinese power inverters.

articles.title: ChatGPT and Roblox will reportedly be subject to tighter rules in the EU - Engadget
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT and Roblox will reportedly be subject to tighter rules in the EU - Engadget
articles.titleKo: ChatGPT와 Roblox는 EU에서 더 엄격한 규칙을 적용받을 것으로 알려졌습니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
The European Union is gearing up to label ChatGPT and Roblox as "very large online platforms," according to Bloomberg .
While it does mean that they're widely used in the block, it also subjects them to stricter rules and gives them more requirements to comply with.
Under the EU's Digital Services Act (DSA), platforms and search engines with more than 45 million users a month in the region are given the designation.

이는 블록에서 널리 사용된다는 것을 의미하지만 더 엄격한 규칙을 적용하고 준수해야 할 더 많은 요구 사항을 제공함

Google DeepMind just released a new version of its artificial intelligence model Gemini , and it can control a range of different robots—including humanoids capable of dextrous tasks like screwing in lightbulbs and tying trash bags.
