articles.title: After shocking quarter, IBM insists that AI isn't killing the mainframe
articles.titleEn: After shocking quarter, IBM insists that AI isn't killing the mainframe
articles.titleKo: 충격적인 분기 이후 IBM은 AI가 메인프레임을 죽이지 않는다고 주장
articles.summary:
While the 115-year-old company still generates boatloads of cash — $17.2 billion in revenue, $9.9 billion in gross profit, nearly 58% margins, and $2.2 billion in net earnings for the quarter — its results fell well short of Wall Street’s expectations.
That’s a cascading problem, because as CFO Jim Kavanaugh explained on the quarterly call with investors, IBM earns $3 in software revenue for every $1 of mainframe hardware it sells.
On Wednesday, IBM also lowered its full-year growth forecasts, meaning this horrible quarter would impact the rest of the year.

OpenAI said Tuesday that AI is accelerating the discovery and exploitation of vulnerabilities, which means model security and safety need to keep up.

articles.summary:
The company says 3.6 Flash delivers stronger coding, knowledge work and multimodal performance while using up to 17% fewer output tokens than its predecessor at a lower price, while Flash-Lite is optimized for latency and scale.
Google unveiled three new Gemini models aimed at AI agents: Gemini 3.6 Flash, which it said is more capable, but also more token-efficient than its predecessor 3.5 Flash; 3.5 Flash-Lite, an even lower-cost, fast inference model for high-volume workloads; and 3.5 Flash Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model designed to find and patch software vulnerabilities.
Nader Henein, VP analyst at tech research firm Gartner , told the trade publication CIO that “self-regulation is not viable,” that “most tech vendors don’t have the capacity to self-regulate” and that self-regulation would necessarily result in conflicts of interest.

articles.titleKo: Microsoft와 Mistral은 전략적 파트너십을 확대하여 기업과 규제 산업에 제어 가능한 AI를 제공함 · - Source
articles.summary:
Mistral is adding its GPU capacity, drawing on thousands of the latest NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPUs to increase AI compute availability for customers and provide a shared platform for training, inference and large-scale deployment.
Microsoft will leverage Mistral’s expanded Europe-based GPU infrastructure to increase capacity for AI development and to support the delivery of MSFT’s cloud and AI services.
Consistent with Microsoft’s flexible approach to global infrastructure, which combines its own datacenters, leased facilities and strategic collaborations with third-party providers, it expands Microsoft’s capacity footprint in Europe and supports the European Digital Commitments announced in 2025.

articles.title: ADBE Stock Drops After Morgan Stanley Downgrade – Sees ‘Cleaner Growth And AI Monetization Elsewhere’
articles.titleEn: ADBE Stock Drops After Morgan Stanley Downgrade – Sees ‘Cleaner Growth And AI Monetization Elsewhere’
articles.titleKo: Morgan Stanley 다운그레이드 후 ADBE 주식 하락 – '다른 곳에서 더 깨끗한 성장과 AI 수익화' 확인
articles.summary:
Morgan Stanley said it sees "cleaner growth and AI monetization elsewhere" within the software sector, supporting a relative 'Underweight' stance on Adobe compared to peers better positioned to capitalize on AI.
Wood stated that Adobe's simultaneous transitions, shifting toward a freemium model, changes in company leadership, and ongoing reinvestment into the business, are compounding execution risk at a moment when generative AI disruption is clouding the company's path back to accelerating annual recurring revenue growth.
Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Wood cut Adobe's rating to 'Underweight' from 'Equal Weight', and cut the price target to $240 from $365, as per a note to investors cited by TheFly.

Wood stated that Adobe's simultaneous transitions, shifting toward a freemium model, changes in company leadership, and ongoing reinvestment into the business, are compounding execution risk at a moment when generative AI disruption is clouding the company's path back to accelerating annual recurring revenue growth.

summaryLinesKo: Morgan Stanley는 소프트웨어 부문 내에서 "다른 곳에서 보다 깨끗한 성장과 AI 수익화"를 보고 있으며, 이는 AI를 활용하기에 더 나은 위치에 있는 경쟁업체에 비해 Adobe에 대한 상대적인 '비중 축소' 입장을 뒷받침한다고 밝힘
Wood는 Adobe의 동시 전환, 부분 유료화 모델로의 전환, 회사 리더십의 변화, 지속적인 비즈니스 재투자가 생성적 AI 중단으로 인해 회사가 연간 반복 수익 성장을 가속화하는 길을 흐리게 하는 순간 실행 위험을 가중시키고 있다고 밝힘
Morgan Stanley의 애널리스트인 Adam Wood는 TheFly가 투자자에게 보낸 메모에 따라 Adobe의 등급을 'Equal Weight'에서 'Underweight'로 낮추고 목표 가격을 365달러에서 240달러로 낮췄음

articles.title: AI and the rise of the universal entertainment app
articles.titleEn: AI and the rise of the universal entertainment app
articles.titleKo: AI와 유니버설 엔터테인먼트 앱의 부상
articles.summary:
The market for entertainment apps is reaching maturity, so growth has slowed, pushing companies to compete on time spent and revenue-per-user instead of new sign-ups.
Meanwhile, YouTube, originally the home to longer-form creator content, moved into short-form content to compete with TikTok, while also adding dedicated space for podcasts , gaming content, music, movies and TV, sports and news, shopping, and more.
After adding podcasts, the company added support for video podcasts, social features like Q&As and commenting, stories , and messaging , as well as different types of content like fitness classes , audiobooks , narrated magazines , and even physical book sales .

After adding podcasts, the company added support for video podcasts, social features like Q&As and commenting, stories , and messaging , as well as different types of content like fitness classes , audiobooks , narrated magazines , and even physical book sales .

한편 원래 긴 형식의 제작자 콘텐츠의 본거지였던 YouTube는 TikTok과 경쟁하기 위해 짧은 형식의 콘텐츠로 이동하는 동시에 팟캐스트, 게임 콘텐츠, 음악, 영화 및 TV, 스포츠 및 뉴스, 쇼핑 등을 위한 전용 공간도 추가함

articles.title: Advancing next-gen AI with materials science innovation
articles.titleEn: Advancing next-gen AI with materials science innovation
articles.titleKo: 재료과학 혁신으로 차세대 AI 발전
articles.summary:
Every increase in computing performance increases the physical demands placed on the systems that make and run AI.
For example, as data centers shift to higher-voltage architectures and greater power density, many of the materials challenges we face closely mirror those of electric vehicles.
But by accelerating the earliest stages of discovery, AI can help materials innovation keep pace with the evolving needs of industries such as semiconductors, electronics, and data centers.

articles.title: Western Sydney University embraces Microsoft Copilot for all staff - Source Asia
articles.titleEn: Western Sydney University embraces Microsoft Copilot for all staff - Source Asia
articles.titleKo: Western Sydney University, 모든 직원을 위해 Microsoft Copilot 채택 - Source Asia
articles.summary:
The partnership builds on a Memorandum of Understanding signed with Microsoft in late 2025 and reflects Western Sydney University’s human-centred approach to AI adoption.
The rollout follows a successful 100-user pilot trial, which demonstrated how Copilot can help minimise the time staff spent on repetitive and low value tasks, freeing them up to work on more high value and meaningful work.
Alongside the University’s investment, Microsoft will provide additional support, assisting with staff training and effective adoption – including capability development in areas such as agentic AI, curriculum design and student engagement.

Alongside the University’s investment, Microsoft will provide additional support, assisting with staff training and effective adoption – including capability development in areas such as agentic AI, curriculum design and student engagement.

이 출시는 Copilot이 직원이 반복적이고 가치가 낮은 작업에 소요되는 시간을 최소화하여 보다 가치 있고 의미 있는 작업에 집중할 수 있도록 돕는 방법을 보여주는 성공적인 100명의 사용자 파일럿 시험에 이어 이루어졌음

articles.title: The Self-Driving Company Is AI’s Next Business Model.
articles.titleEn: The Self-Driving Company Is AI’s Next Business Model.
articles.titleKo: 자율주행 회사는 AI의 차세대 비즈니스 모델임
articles.summary:
Replit's "Self-Driving Company" model demonstrates significant gains: a 5.8x increase in code contributions, nearly tripled output per engineer, and 30% faster code reviews.
At Replit, agents investigate production incidents, answer product questions, analyze business data, enrich sales leads, build account-specific presentations, and triage support tickets.
I map enterprise AI adoption on a model I call the 4 phase RISE adoption model: Phase 1: Research & Education, Phase 2: Islands of Innovation, Phase 3: Scaling, and Phase 4: Emergent Intelligence.

articles.summary:
Roberts said Zillow's ability to credibly attribute a 40% increase in shipped code to AI adoption rests on a DORA metrics baseline the team put in place years earlier, not on the AI rollout itself.
"Claude is also very slow because the first part of assembling that context actually takes forever," Jain said.
Zillow chose to own that layer itself rather than depend on a single external chat interface, a decision Roberts said the team reached quickly once it looked at the shape of a real transaction rather than a single conversation.

Elsewhere, everything else, from the iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Plus down to the iPhone 11, gets iOS 27 without Apple Intelligence or the new Siri.
However, iOS 27's headline additions, such as the new Siri AI and expanded Apple Intelligence features, depend on hardware, which effectively splits supported iPhones into three separate tiers.
According to supply chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo , the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e will include 9GB of RAM, which is enough for standard Apple Intelligence features, but it's still short of the 12GB needed for the top-tier features.

articles.title: Writer's AI harness cuts token spend 38% | VentureBeat
articles.titleEn: Writer's AI harness cuts token spend 38% | VentureBeat
articles.titleKo: 작가의 AI 하네스로 토큰 지출 38% 절감 | 벤처비트
articles.summary:
Task success rates held steady even as token use fell — moving from 78% to 81%, a gain the researchers describe as directional rather than statistically significant at their sample size, meaning quality didn't suffer even as costs dropped.
By optimizing the harness, the researchers show dramatic reductions in tokens per task, a drop in cost-per-successful-task by up to 61%, and quality that holds steady, all without changing the underlying foundation model.
Token consumption of tokenmaxxing vs harness optimization (source: arXiv) The optimized harness drove a significant drop in costs, cutting the blended cost per task by 41%, from 21 cents to 12 cents.

articles.title: Why South Korea is racing to build a sovereign AI model for cybersecurity
articles.titleEn: Why South Korea is racing to build a sovereign AI model for cybersecurity
articles.titleKo: 한국이 사이버 보안을 위한 주권적 AI 모델 구축을 위해 경쟁하는 이유
articles.summary:
Fears over access to foreign AI models have accelerated Seoul’s push to control the systems used to defend critical infrastructure But Seoul’s more ambitious, longer-term goal of building a frontier model capable of competing with the world’s most advanced systems would require it to overcome a persistent gap in AI software, computing capacity and large-scale training, analysts said.
“AI can be used to identify security vulnerabilities and exploit them with ease, so we need to prepare our defences accordingly,” he said.
Science and ICT Minister Bae Kyung-hoon unveiled the plan on Thursday after Washington imposed new export restrictions on several advanced AI models, including Anthropic’s Mythos 5.

articles.title: AI infrastructure spending outpaces control | VentureBeat
articles.titleEn: AI infrastructure spending outpaces control | VentureBeat
articles.titleKo: AI 인프라 지출이 통제를 앞지르다 | 벤처비트
articles.summary:
Only about one in five (21%) run AI in production at scale, yet spending intentions are outrunning that maturity: the single largest planned area enterprises plan to evaluate over the next year is AI-specialized clouds (45%), a layer almost none of these enterprises use today.
Across 107 enterprises, AI infrastructure spending is accelerating well ahead of the ability to see or steer its economics.
When they choose, they choose on integration with the existing stack (41%) and total cost of ownership (35%), not on headline price: cost per million tokens is the deciding factor for just 8%.

articles.title: The agent security gap: 54% of enterprises have already had an AI agent incident, and most still let agents share credentials
articles.titleEn: The agent security gap: 54% of enterprises have already had an AI agent incident, and most still let agents share credentials
articles.titleKo: 에이전트 보안 격차 · 기업의 54%가 이미 AI 에이전트 사고를 겪었으며 대부분 여전히 에이전트가 자격 증명을 공유하도록 허용함
articles.summary:
Nearly half (48%) say some agents have scoped identities but many still share credentials, and another 32% say agents mostly run on shared API keys or borrowed human and service-account credentials.
When agents share credentials, a single compromised or over-permissioned agent carries a wide blast radius — and only three in ten enterprises (30%) isolate their highest-risk agents in sandboxes to bound that radius.
More than half have already had a confirmed agent security incident or a near-miss; only about a third give every agent its own scoped identity, and most agents still share credentials; and only three in ten isolate their highest-risk agents.

articles.summary:

A working version of ‌Apple Intelligence‌ could help sustain that momentum, though Apple is still catching up to domestic rivals that built AI features into their phones well before it did.

articles.title: At last, a good reason to buy an AI PC: Reining in runaway token bills
articles.titleEn: At last, a good reason to buy an AI PC: Reining in runaway token bills
articles.titleKo: 마침내 AI PC를 구입해야 할 좋은 이유 · 폭주하는 토큰 청구서 억제
articles.summary:
“Enterprises are becoming increasingly concerned about the economic sustainability of cloud-centric AI strategies as token consumption and associated usage costs continue to rise, driving greater interest in a hybrid strategy, by identifying workloads that can be processed more efficiently at the edge or on the device itself.”
The analyst therefore offered two numerical predictions: By 2029, 30 percent of enterprises will be using AI PCs to reduce their cloud AI token costs; By 2030, 70 percent of the corporate PC installed base will be capable of running some local GenAI workloads.
“On -device AI has yet to achieve mainstream adoption and remains largely confined to developer and enthusiast use cases,” he added.

articles.title: Introducing Claude for Teachers
articles.titleEn: Introducing Claude for Teachers
articles.titleKo: 교사를 위한 Claude 소개
articles.summary:
This is the aim of Claude for Teachers: support the craft behind great teaching and protect what teachers value most—time with their students.
Connected to evidence-based curricula and the K-12 ecosystem Claude for Teachers connects to Learning Commons , giving Claude access to academic standards across all 50 states—and beneath each standard, the smaller learning competencies it's built from and the order students typically learn them.
Early evidence suggests that while the impact of AI tools for students is mixed and depends on the implementation, AI tools for teachers can strengthen instructional practice and improve student outcomes.

Connected to evidence-based curricula and the K-12 ecosystem Claude for Teachers connects to Learning Commons , giving Claude access to academic standards across all 50 states—and beneath each standard, the smaller learning competencies it's built from and the order students typically learn them.

Early evidence suggests that while the impact of AI tools for students is mixed and depends on the implementation, AI tools for teachers can strengthen instructional practice and improve student outcomes.
summaryLinesKo: 이것이 Claude for Teachers의 목표임 · 훌륭한 교육을 뒷받침하는 기술을 지원하고 교사가 가장 중요하게 생각하는 것, 즉 학생들과 함께하는 시간을 보호하는 것임
증거 기반 커리큘럼 및 K-12 생태계에 연결된 Claude for Teachers는 Learning Commons에 연결되어 Claude가 50개 주 전체의 학업 표준에 액세스할 수 있게 하며, 각 표준 아래에는 작은 학습 역량과 학생들이 일반적으로 학습하는 순서가 표시됨
